units.sourceText: 给你一把整装好的椅子我一直想送给你一把椅子作为礼物，因为我知道英雄偶尔也可以好好休息一下。
units.referenceText: Here, a fully-assembled chair, just for you! I've always wanted to give you a chair as a gift, because I know a hero can occasionally use some good rest. Tee hee.
units.targetZh: 给你一把整装好的椅子我一直想送给你一把椅子作为礼物，因为我知道英雄偶尔也可以好好休息一下。

units.sourceText: 英雄不是不可战胜的。英雄是人。我相信你有时会面对挑战甚至犹豫不决。但你是英雄，因为你有能力克服你可能遇到的任何障碍。
units.referenceText: A hero is not invincible. A hero is human. I'm sure you will face challenges and even falter at times. But you are a hero because you have what it takes to overcome any obstacles you may encounter.
units.targetZh: 英雄不是不可战胜的。英雄是人。我相信你有时会面对挑战甚至犹豫不决。但你是英雄，因为你有能力克服你可能遇到的任何障碍。

units.sourceText: 那么，说明就到此结束，现在进入下一阶段。下一个阶段是什么呢？刚刚才跟您说过不是吗？要修炼变强盗你可以除掉黑魔法师的程度。
units.referenceText: Alright, I've done enough explaining for now. Let's move on to the next stage. What's the next stage, you ask? I just told you. Train as hard as you can until you become strong enough to defeat the Black Mage with a single blow.
units.targetZh: 那么，说明就到此结束，现在进入下一阶段。下一个阶段是什么呢？刚刚才跟您说过不是吗？要修炼变强盗你可以除掉黑魔法师的程度。

units.sourceText: 您虽然过去是英雄，可是那已经是几百年前的事了。就算不是黑魔法师的诅咒，待在冰雪当中这么长的时间，身体一定会变得很僵硬吧！首先先松开僵硬的身体。您觉得如何？
units.referenceText: You may have been a hero in the past, but that was hundreds of years ago. Even if it weren't for the curse of the Black Mage, all those years you spent frozen in time have stiffened your body. You must loosen up a bit and slowly regain your agility. How do you do that, you ask?
units.targetZh: 您虽然过去是英雄，可是那已经是几百年前的事了。就算不是黑魔法师的诅咒，待在冰雪当中这么长的时间，身体一定会变得很僵硬吧！首先先松开僵硬的身体。您觉得如何？

units.sourceText: 体力就是战力！英雄的基础就是体力！ ... 您没听过这些话吗？当然要先做#b基础体力锻炼#k ... 啊！ 您丧失记忆所以什么都忘了。不知道也没关系。那么现在就进入基础体力锻炼吧！
units.referenceText: Don't you know that you must first master the fundamentals? So the wise thing to do is to begin with #bBasic Training#k. Oh, of course, I forgot that you lost your memory. Well, that's why I'm here. You'll just have to experience it yourself. Shall we begin?
units.targetZh: 体力就是战力！英雄的基础就是体力！ ... 您没听过这些话吗？当然要先做#b基础体力锻炼#k ... 啊！ 您丧失记忆所以什么都忘了。不知道也没关系。那么现在就进入基础体力锻炼吧！

units.sourceText: 你还犹豫什么？你可是英雄啊！机不可失，时不再来！来吧，我们上！
units.referenceText: What are you so hesitant about? You're a hero! You gotta strike while the iron is hot! Come on, let's do this!
units.targetZh: 你还犹豫什么？你可是英雄啊！机不可失，时不再来！来吧，我们上！

units.sourceText: 虽然里恩岛的居民大多是企鹅，但这座岛上也有怪物。如果你前往位于城镇右侧的#b#m140020000##k，你会发现#o0100131#s。请击败#r10只#o0100131#s#k。我相信这对你来说轻而易举，毕竟就连这里最菜的企鹅都能打败它们。
units.referenceText: The population of Rien may be mostly Penguins, but even this island has monsters. You'll find #o0100131#s if you go to #b#m140020000##k, located on the right side of the town. Please defeat #r10 of those #o0100131#s#k. I'm sure you'll have no trouble defeating the #o0100131#s that even the slowest penguins here can defeat.
units.targetZh: 虽然里恩岛的居民大多是企鹅，但这座岛上也有怪物。如果你前往位于城镇右侧的#b#m140020000##k，你会发现#o0100131#s。请击败#r10只#o0100131#s#k。我相信这对你来说轻而易举，毕竟就连这里最菜的企鹅都能打败它们。

units.sourceText: “我们继续你的基础训练吗？在接受之前，请确保你已经正确装备好你的剑，并且你的技能和药水触手可及。”
units.referenceText: Shall we continue with your Basic Training? Before accepting, please make sure you have properly equipped your sword and your skills and potions are readily accessible.
units.targetZh: “我们继续你的基础训练吗？在接受之前，请确保你已经正确装备好你的剑，并且你的技能和药水触手可及。”

units.sourceText: “你还没准备好猎取#o0100132#s吗？只有在完全准备好的情况下才能继续。未经充分准备就投入战斗是最糟糕的事情。”
units.referenceText: Are you not ready to hunt the #o0100132#s yet? Always proceed if and only if you are fully ready. There's nothing worse than engaging in battles without sufficient preparation.
units.targetZh: “你还没准备好猎取#o0100132#s吗？只有在完全准备好的情况下才能继续。未经充分准备就投入战斗是最糟糕的事情。”

units.sourceText: “好的。这次，让你打败#r#o0100132#s#k，它们比#o0100131#s稍微强大一些。前往#b#m140020100##k并打败#r15#k只它们。那应该能帮助你增强力量。好的！我们开始吧！”
units.referenceText: Alright. This time, let's have you defeat #r#o0100132#s#k, which are slightly more powerful than #o0100131#s. Head over to #b#m140020100##k and defeat #r15#k of them. That should help you build your strength. Alright! Let's do this!
units.targetZh: “好的。这次，让你打败#r#o0100132#s#k，它们比#o0100131#s稍微强大一些。前往#b#m140020100##k并打败#r15#k只它们。那应该能帮助你增强力量。好的！我们开始吧！”

units.sourceText: “看来你现在已经热身了。这时候严格的训练真的能帮助你打下坚实的基础。我们开始基础训练吧，好吗？”
units.referenceText: It seems like you're warmed up now. This is when rigorous training can really help you build a strong foundation. Let's proceed with the Basic Training, shall we?
units.targetZh: “看来你现在已经热身了。这时候严格的训练真的能帮助你打下坚实的基础。我们开始基础训练吧，好吗？”

units.sourceText: 这次去#b#m140020200##k打败一些 #r#o0100133##k。我想大约#r20#k就行了。继续前进……嗯？你有什么想说的吗？?
units.referenceText: Go defeat some #r#o0100133#s#k in #b#m140020200##k this time. I think about  #r20#k should do it. Go on ahead and... Hm? Do you have something you'd like to say?
units.targetZh: 这次去#b#m140020200##k打败一些 #r#o0100133##k。我想大约#r20#k就行了。继续前进……嗯？你有什么想说的吗？?

units.sourceText: “数字不是越来越大了吗”?
units.referenceText: Isn't the number getting bigger and bigger?
units.targetZh: “数字不是越来越大了吗”?

units.sourceText: “当然是这样。怎么，你对20不满意吗？你想打败100个吗？哦，那999个怎么样？沉睡森林里有人能轻松做到。毕竟，我们正在训练……”
units.referenceText: Of course it is. What, are you not happy with 20? Would you like to defeat 100 of them instead? Oh, how about 999 of them? Someone in Sleepywood would be able to do it easily. After all, we are training...
units.targetZh: “当然是这样。怎么，你对20不满意吗？你想打败100个吗？哦，那999个怎么样？沉睡森林里有人能轻松做到。毕竟，我们正在训练……”

units.sourceText: “哦不，不，不。二十已经足够了”.
units.referenceText: Oh no, no, no. Twenty is plenty.
units.targetZh: “哦不，不，不。二十已经足够了”.

units.sourceText: “你不必如此谦虚。我理解你想要快速成为曾经的英雄的愿望。这种态度正是你成为英雄的原因。”.
units.referenceText: You don't have to be so modest. I understand your desire to quickly become the hero you once were. This sort of attitude is what makes you a hero.
units.targetZh: “你不必如此谦虚。我理解你想要快速成为曾经的英雄的愿望。这种态度正是你成为英雄的原因。”.

units.sourceText: #b(“你因为害怕而拒绝了，但你不能就这样逃避。深呼吸，冷静下来，然后再试一次。”)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You declined out of fear, but it's not like you can run away like this. Take a big breath, calm down, and try again.)#k
units.targetZh: #b(“你因为害怕而拒绝了，但你不能就这样逃避。深呼吸，冷静下来，然后再试一次。”)#k

units.sourceText: #b(“你接受了，想着如果让她继续说下去，你可能最终要处理999个这样的请求。”)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You accepted, thinking you might end up having to 999 of them if you let her keep talking.)#k
units.targetZh: #b(“你接受了，想着如果让她继续说下去，你可能最终要处理999个这样的请求。”)#k

units.referenceText: Please go ahead and slay 20 #o0100133#s.

units.sourceText: 来，让我测试一下，你至今为止的基础体力训练结果。测试方法很简单。这座岛上有一种最强悍凶猛的怪兽，#o0100134#。大约#r50#k只就可以了，但是...
units.referenceText: Now, you will undergo a test that will determine whether you're fit or not. All you have to do is take on the most powerful monster on this island, #o0100134#s. About #r50#k of them would suffice, but...
units.targetZh: 来，让我测试一下，你至今为止的基础体力训练结果。测试方法很简单。这座岛上有一种最强悍凶猛的怪兽，#o0100134#。大约#r50#k只就可以了，但是...

units.sourceText: 不过#o0100134#的数量本来就不多，杀掉那么多恐怕不利生态平衡的保持，你消灭5只就差不多了。你看，这训练与自然环境之间是多么滴和谐啊！真是完美啊……
units.referenceText: We can't have you wipe out the entire population of #o0100134#s, since they aren't many of them out there. How about 5 of them? You're here to train, not to destroy the ecosystem.
units.targetZh: 不过#o0100134#的数量本来就不多，杀掉那么多恐怕不利生态平衡的保持，你消灭5只就差不多了。你看，这训练与自然环境之间是多么滴和谐啊！真是完美啊……

units.sourceText: 哦，五只还不够吗？如果你觉得需要进一步训练，请随意多杀几只。如果你杀掉全部，我也只能忍痛装作看不见，毕竟它们是为了你而被牺牲的……
units.referenceText: Oh, is 5 not enough? If you feel the need to train further, please feel free to slay more than that. If you slay all of them, I'll just have to look the other way even if it breaks my heart, since they will have been sacrificed for a good cause...
units.targetZh: 哦，五只还不够吗？如果你觉得需要进一步训练，请随意多杀几只。如果你杀掉全部，我也只能忍痛装作看不见，毕竟它们是为了你而被牺牲的……

units.sourceText: #o0100134#在岛的较深处。村子左边的路一直走，就能看到#b#m140010200##k，请去那里消灭#r5只#o0100134#s#k。
units.referenceText: #o0100134#s can be found in deeper parts of the island. Continue going left until you reach #b#m140010200##k, and defeat #r5 #o0100134#s#k.
units.targetZh: #o0100134#在岛的较深处。村子左边的路一直走，就能看到#b#m140010200##k，请去那里消灭#r5只#o0100134#s#k。

units.sourceText: 和黑魔法师决斗的英雄...几乎没有任何相关的资讯保存下来。预言书上也只记录有五名英雄，没有任何和外貌有关的资料。你难道什么都想不起来吗？
units.referenceText: There isn't much record left of the heroes that fought against the Black Mage. Even in the Book of Prophecy, the only information available is that there were five of them. There is nothing about who they were or what they looked like. Is there anything you remember? Anything at all?
units.targetZh: 和黑魔法师决斗的英雄...几乎没有任何相关的资讯保存下来。预言书上也只记录有五名英雄，没有任何和外貌有关的资料。你难道什么都想不起来吗？

units.sourceText: 什么都想不起来...
units.referenceText: I don't remember a thing...
units.targetZh: 什么都想不起来...

units.sourceText: 原来如此。黑魔法师的诅咒不会那么容易就被解除。可是就算如此，英雄您和过去之间应该有什么连结。到底有什么武器呢？因为决斗的关系，武器或衣服都不见了...啊！对了！ #b武器#k！
units.referenceText: As I expected. Of course, the curse of the Black Mage was strong enough to wipe out all of your memory. But even if that's the case, there has got to be a point where the past will uncover, especially now that we are certain you are one of the heroes. I know you've lost your armor and weapon during the battle but... Oh, yes, yes. I almost forgot! Your #bweapon#k!
units.targetZh: 原来如此。黑魔法师的诅咒不会那么容易就被解除。可是就算如此，英雄您和过去之间应该有什么连结。到底有什么武器呢？因为决斗的关系，武器或衣服都不见了...啊！对了！ #b武器#k！

units.sourceText: 武器？
units.referenceText: My weapon?
units.targetZh: 武器？

units.sourceText: 之前在冰雪中挖掘英雄时曾经找到一些厉害的武器。当时推测应该是英雄使用过的东西，因此保存在村庄中央。您经过时没看到吗？ #b#p1201001##k... #i4032372#长成这样...
units.referenceText: I found an incredible weapon while digging through blocks of ice a while back. I figured the weapon belonged to a hero, so I brought it to town and placed it somewhere in the center of the town. Haven't you seen it? #bThe #p1201001##k... #i4032372#It looks like this...
units.targetZh: 之前在冰雪中挖掘英雄时曾经找到一些厉害的武器。当时推测应该是英雄使用过的东西，因此保存在村庄中央。您经过时没看到吗？ #b#p1201001##k... #i4032372#长成这样...

units.sourceText: 难怪我觉得很奇怪，有把 #p1201001# 就在村庄里面...
units.referenceText: Come to think of it, I did see a #p1201001# in town.
units.targetZh: 难怪我觉得很奇怪，有把 #p1201001# 就在村庄里面...

units.sourceText: 是，就是那个。根据纪录英雄的武器会认主人。假如您是使用 #p1201001#的英雄，抓住 #p1201001#时应该会有什么反应。快点去按#b#p1201001#吧。#k
units.referenceText: Yes, that's it. According to what's been recorded, the weapon of a hero will recognize its rightful owner, and if you're the hero that used the #p1201001#, the #p1201001# will react when you grab the #p1201001#. Please go find the #b#p1201001# and click on it.#k
units.targetZh: 是，就是那个。根据纪录英雄的武器会认主人。假如您是使用 #p1201001#的英雄，抓住 #p1201001#时应该会有什么反应。快点去按#b#p1201001#吧。#k

units.sourceText: 还在犹豫什么？我保证，就算#p1201001#对你毫无反应，我也不会失望。拜托，快过去找#p1201001#。只要#b点击#k它就行。
units.referenceText: What's stopping you? I promise, I won't be disappointed even if the #p1201001# shows no reaction to you. Please, rush over there and grab the #p1201001#. Just #bclick#k on it.
units.targetZh: 还在犹豫什么？我保证，就算#p1201001#对你毫无反应，我也不会失望。拜托，快过去找#p1201001#。只要#b点击#k它就行。

units.sourceText: 假如 #p1201001#有反应的话，您就使用#p1201001#的英雄 #b狂狼勇士#k.
units.referenceText: If the #p1201001# reacts to you, then we'll know that you're #bAran#k, the hero that wielded a #p1201001#.
units.targetZh: 假如 #p1201001#有反应的话，您就使用#p1201001#的英雄 #b狂狼勇士#k.

units.sourceText: #b(“你需要考虑一下这个...”)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You need to think about this for a second...)#k
units.targetZh: #b(“你需要考虑一下这个...”)#k

units.sourceText: #b(“你确定你就是那个挥舞#p1201001#的英雄吗？是的，你确定。你最好紧紧握住#p1201001#。它肯定会对你有所反应。”)#k
units.referenceText: #b(Are you certain that you were the hero that wielded the #p1201001#? Yes, you're sure. You better grab the #p1201001# really tightly. Surely it will react to you.)#k
units.targetZh: #b(“你确定你就是那个挥舞#p1201001#的英雄吗？是的，你确定。你最好紧紧握住#p1201001#。它肯定会对你有所反应。”)#k

units.sourceText: “哇，你的#b装备栏#k已满。你需要腾出至少一个空位来完成这个任务。”.
units.referenceText: Wow, your #bequip#k inventory is full. You need to make at least 1 empty slot to complete this quest.
units.targetZh: “哇，你的#b装备栏#k已满。你需要腾出至少一个空位来完成这个任务。”.

units.sourceText: #b(你可能开始记起某些事了……)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You might be starting to remember something...)#k
units.targetZh: #b(你可能开始记起某些事了……)#k

units.sourceText: 当你明智地接受了你的决定后再回来。
units.referenceText: Come back again when you have took your desition wisely.
units.targetZh: 当你明智地接受了你的决定后再回来。

units.sourceText: 训练进展如何？哇，你达到了这么高的水平！太棒了。我知道你在维多利亚岛会做得很好。。。哦，看看我。我在浪费你的时间。我知道你很忙，但你得回岛上一会儿。
units.referenceText: How is the training going? Wow, you've reached such a high level! That's amazing. I knew you would do just fine on Victoria Island... Oh, look at me. I'm wasting your time. I know you're busy, but you'll have to return to the island for a bit.
units.targetZh: 训练进展如何？哇，你达到了这么高的水平！太棒了。我知道你在维多利亚岛会做得很好。。。哦，看看我。我在浪费你的时间。我知道你很忙，但你得回岛上一会儿。

units.sourceText: 你的#b#p1201001###b#m140000000##k突然变得奇怪起来。据记载，北极熊在召唤主人的时候会这样做。#它在召唤你。请回到岛上，检查一下。
units.referenceText: Your #b#p1201001##k in #b#m140000000##k is acting strange all of a sudden. According to the records, the Polearm acts this way when it is calling for its master. #bPerhaps it's calling for you#k. Please return to the island and check things out.
units.targetZh: 你的#b#p1201001###b#m140000000##k突然变得奇怪起来。据记载，北极熊在召唤主人的时候会这样做。#它在召唤你。请回到岛上，检查一下。

units.sourceText: 嘿！至少你试过了!
units.referenceText: Hey! At least say you tried!
units.targetZh: 嘿！至少你试过了!

units.sourceText: 嗡 嗡 嗡 嗡 嗡....
units.referenceText: Voom voom voom voom voom....
units.targetZh: 嗡 嗡 嗡 嗡 嗡....

units.sourceText: #b(#p1201001#产生了一个起伏的回波。但是站在那边的那个男孩是谁?)
units.referenceText: #b(The #p1201001# is producing an undulating echo. But who is that boy standing over there?)
units.targetZh: #b(#p1201001#产生了一个起伏的回波。但是站在那边的那个男孩是谁?)

units.sourceText: #b(你以前从没见过他。他看起来不像人.)
units.referenceText: #b(You've never seen him before. He doesn't look human.)
units.targetZh: #b(你以前从没见过他。他看起来不像人.)

units.sourceText: 哟，战神！你没听见吗？我说，你没听见吗！呃，真是郁闷!
units.referenceText: Yo, Aran! Do you not hear me? I said, do you not hear me! Ugh, how frustating!
units.targetZh: 哟，战神！你没听见吗？我说，你没听见吗！呃，真是郁闷!

units.sourceText: #b(嗯？那是谁的声音？听起来像个愤怒的男孩。。。)
units.referenceText: #b(Hm? Who's voice was that? It sounds like an angry boy...)
units.targetZh: #b(嗯？那是谁的声音？听起来像个愤怒的男孩。。。)

units.sourceText: 啊，我唯一的主人被困在冰里几百年，完全抛弃了我，现在完全无视我.
units.referenceText: Ugh, my only master had to end up trapped in ice for hundreds of years, abandoning me completely, and is now completely ignoring me.
units.targetZh: 啊，我唯一的主人被困在冰里几百年，完全抛弃了我，现在完全无视我.

units.sourceText: 你是谁？
units.referenceText: Who...are you?
units.targetZh: 你是谁？

units.sourceText: 战神,你现在听到我说话了吗？是我！你不认识我吗？我是你的武器，#b#p1201002#战矛#k!
units.referenceText: Aran? Do you hear me now? It's me! Don't you recognize me? I'm your weapon, #b#p1201002# the Polearm#k!
units.targetZh: 战神,你现在听到我说话了吗？是我！你不认识我吗？我是你的武器，#b#p1201002#战矛#k!

units.sourceText: 你脸上那可疑的表情是怎么回事？我知道你失忆了，但你也忘了我吗？你怎么能？!
units.referenceText: What's with that suspicious look on your face? I know you've lost your memory, but did you forgot about me, too? How could you?!
units.targetZh: 你脸上那可疑的表情是怎么回事？我知道你失忆了，但你也忘了我吗？你怎么能？!

units.sourceText: 很抱歉，但我什么都记不起来了。
units.referenceText: I'm so sorry, but I can't remember a thing.
units.targetZh: 很抱歉，但我什么都记不起来了。

units.sourceText: 对不起，说什么都没有用！你知道几百年来我是多么孤独和无聊吗？我不在乎它需要什么！记住我！现在记住我!
units.referenceText: Sorry doesn't cut it! Do you know how lonely and bored I was for hundreds of years? I don't care what it takes! Remember me! Remember me now!
units.targetZh: 对不起，说什么都没有用！你知道几百年来我是多么孤独和无聊吗？我不在乎它需要什么！记住我！现在记住我!

units.sourceText: #b(自称是#p1201002#这个#p1201001#在沮丧中大叫, 你不认为这次谈话会有任何进展。你最好去和我谈谈#p1201000#.)
units.referenceText: #b(The voice that claims to be #p1201002# the #p1201001# is yelling in frustration. You don't think this conversation is going anywhere. You better go talk to #p1201000# first.)
units.targetZh: #b(自称是#p1201002#这个#p1201001#在沮丧中大叫, 你不认为这次谈话会有任何进展。你最好去和我谈谈#p1201000#.)

units.sourceText: “嘿！至少说你试过了”!
units.referenceText: Hey! At least say you tried!
units.targetZh: “嘿！至少说你试过了”!

units.sourceText: “嘿！至少说你试过了！”
units.referenceText: Hey! At least say you tried!
units.targetZh: “嘿！至少说你试过了！”

units.sourceText: “首先你承诺打败黑魔法师并为我制造一件著名的武器，然后你抛弃我几百年，现在你告诉我你不记得我是谁了？什么？！你以为我会让你逃脱惩罚吗？你是那个乞求并渴望我的人！”
units.referenceText: First you promise to defeat the Black Mage and make me a famous weapon, then you abandon me for hundreds of years, and now you're telling me you don't remember who I am? What the...?! Do you think I will let you get away with that? You're the one who begged and pined for me!
units.targetZh: “首先你承诺打败黑魔法师并为我制造一件著名的武器，然后你抛弃我几百年，现在你告诉我你不记得我是谁了？什么？！你以为我会让你逃脱惩罚吗？你是那个乞求并渴望我的人！”

units.sourceText: “我确实告诉#p1203000#如果我能证明自己的价值，他就为我制作一把长柄武器。”
units.referenceText: I did tell #p1203000# to make a pole arm for me if I could prove my worth.
units.targetZh: “我确实告诉#p1203000#如果我能证明自己的价值，他就为我制作一把长柄武器。”

units.sourceText: 经过了那么多的乞求，你难道不应该对我多一点爱和尊重吗？你知道，像我这样的武器是罕见而美妙的东西。我是终极的#p1201001#，可以帮助你打败黑法师。你怎么能把我抛弃好几百年呢?
units.referenceText: After all that begging, shouldn't you treat me with a little more love and respect? Ya know, a weapon like me's a rare and wonderful thing. I am the ultimate #p1201001# that can help you defeat the Black Mage. How could you ditch me for hundreds of years?
units.targetZh: 经过了那么多的乞求，你难道不应该对我多一点爱和尊重吗？你知道，像我这样的武器是罕见而美妙的东西。我是终极的#p1201001#，可以帮助你打败黑法师。你怎么能把我抛弃好几百年呢?

units.sourceText: “嘿，我从没求过你。”
units.referenceText: Hey, I never begged for you.
units.targetZh: “嘿，我从没求过你。”

units.sourceText: “什么？你从来没为我乞求过？哈哈！ #p1203000# 告诉我你曾经跪下，流着泪为我乞求，而且……等一下。阿伦！你刚刚想起我是谁了吗？”?
units.referenceText: What? You never begged for me? Ha! #p1203000# told me you got on your knees, begged for me in tears, and... Wait a sec. Aran! Did you just remember who I am?
units.targetZh: “什么？你从来没为我乞求过？哈哈！ #p1203000# 告诉我你曾经跪下，流着泪为我乞求，而且……等一下。阿伦！你刚刚想起我是谁了吗？”?

units.sourceText: “也许有一点...”
units.referenceText: Maybe a little bit...
units.targetZh: “也许有一点...”

units.sourceText: “阿兰，是你！*嗅嗅* 等等，*咳* 我没有变得情绪化，只是过敏。我知道黑魔法师夺走了你的能力，所以你可能连把我抱起来的力气都没有……但至少你还记得我！我很高兴你的记忆开始恢复。”
units.referenceText: Aran, it is you! *Sniff sniff* Wait, *ahem* I didn't get emotional, it's just allergies. I know the Black Mage has stripped you of your abilities so you probably don't even have the strength to lift me... but at least you remember me! I'm glad that your memory's starting to return.
units.targetZh: “阿兰，是你！*嗅嗅* 等等，*咳* 我没有变得情绪化，只是过敏。我知道黑魔法师夺走了你的能力，所以你可能连把我抱起来的力气都没有……但至少你还记得我！我很高兴你的记忆开始恢复。”

units.sourceText: “即使你失去了记忆，你仍然是我的主人。你过去经历了一些非常艰苦的训练，我相信你的身体仍然记得那些艰难时光中学到的技能。好吧，我会恢复你的能力。”!
units.referenceText: Even though you've lost your memory, you're still my master. You endured some very tough training in the past, and I'm sure your body still remembers the skills you got through those hard times. Alright, I'll restore your abilities!
units.targetZh: “即使你失去了记忆，你仍然是我的主人。你过去经历了一些非常艰苦的训练，我相信你的身体仍然记得那些艰难时光中学到的技能。好吧，我会恢复你的能力。”!

units.sourceText: “哇，你的#b装备栏#k已满。我需要你至少腾出一个空位来完成这个任务”.
units.referenceText: Wow, your #bequip#k inventory is full. I need you to make at least 1 empty slot to complete this quest.
units.targetZh: “哇，你的#b装备栏#k已满。我需要你至少腾出一个空位来完成这个任务”.

units.sourceText: “你的水平已经不再像往日的辉煌时期了，所以我无法恢复你所有的旧能力。不过，我能恢复的几种能力应该能帮助你更快升级。现在赶紧去训练吧，这样你才能恢复成以前的自己。”
units.referenceText: Your level isn't what it used to be back in your glory days, so I can't restore all of your old abilities. But the few I can restore should help you level up faster. Now hurry up and train so you can return to the old you.
units.targetZh: “你的水平已经不再像往日的辉煌时期了，所以我无法恢复你所有的旧能力。不过，我能恢复的几种能力应该能帮助你更快升级。现在赶紧去训练吧，这样你才能恢复成以前的自己。”

units.sourceText: “你不想努力工作以获得终极武器吗？”
units.referenceText: Do you not want to put in the work to get the ultimate weapon?
units.targetZh: “你不想努力工作以获得终极武器吗？”

units.sourceText: “嗯..像你这样年轻的人在这个偏僻的地方做什么？”
units.referenceText: Hmm.. What's a young person like you doing in this secluded place?
units.targetZh: “嗯..像你这样年轻的人在这个偏僻的地方做什么？”

units.sourceText: “我来拿最好的长柄武器！”
units.referenceText: I've come to get the best Polearm there is!
units.targetZh: “我来拿最好的长柄武器！”

units.sourceText: 最好的长柄武器？你应该能在某个城镇或其他地方购买到它..
units.referenceText: The best Polearm? You should be able to purchase it in some town or other place..
units.targetZh: 最好的长柄武器？你应该能在某个城镇或其他地方购买到它..

units.sourceText: 我听说你是枫叶世界里最好的铁匠！我只想要一件你打造的武器！
units.referenceText: I hear you are the best blacksmith in all of Maple World! I want nothing less than a weapon made by you!
units.targetZh: 我听说你是枫叶世界里最好的铁匠！我只想要一件你打造的武器！

units.sourceText: “我现在太老了，不能再制造武器了，但.. 我确实有一把很久以前做的长柄武器。它现在仍然状况良好。但我不能给你，因为那把长柄武器非常锋利，锋利到甚至会伤害它的主人。你还想要吗？”
units.referenceText: I'm too old to make weapons now, but.. I do have a Polearm that I made way back when. It's still in excellent shape. But I can't give it to you because that Polearm is extremely sharp, so sharp it could hurt its master. Do you still want it?
units.targetZh: “我现在太老了，不能再制造武器了，但.. 我确实有一把很久以前做的长柄武器。它现在仍然状况良好。但我不能给你，因为那把长柄武器非常锋利，锋利到甚至会伤害它的主人。你还想要吗？”

units.sourceText: “好吧，如果你这么说.. 我无法反对。我告诉你。我会给你一个快速测试，如果你通过了，巨型长柄武器就是你的。前往#b训练中心#k并挑战那里的#r伤疤熊#k。你的任务是带回#b30个接受标志#k。”
units.referenceText: Well, if you say so.. I can't object to that. I'll tell you what. I'll give you a quick test, and if you pass it, the Giant Polearm is yours. Head over to the #bTraining Center#k and take on the #rScarred Bears#k that are there. Your job is to bring back #b30 Sign of Acceptances#k.
units.targetZh: “好吧，如果你这么说.. 我无法反对。我告诉你。我会给你一个快速测试，如果你通过了，巨型长柄武器就是你的。前往#b训练中心#k并挑战那里的#r伤疤熊#k。你的任务是带回#b30个接受标志#k。”

units.sourceText: “嗯？经历了这么多之后你现在还犹豫不决吗？好吧，如果你愿意的话再好好考虑考虑。反正最后它会是你的。”
units.referenceText: Hm? Are you hesitant to take it now after all that? Well, give it more thought if you'd like. It'll be yours in the end anyways.
units.targetZh: “嗯？经历了这么多之后你现在还犹豫不决吗？好吧，如果你愿意的话再好好考虑考虑。反正最后它会是你的。”

units.sourceText: “哦，你把#t4032311#带来了吗？你比我想象的要强大！但更重要的是，我对你在毫不犹豫地接下这件危险武器时所表现出的勇气印象深刻。你值得拥有它。#p1201001#是你的了。”
units.referenceText: Oh, have you brought me the #t4032311#? You're stronger than I thought! But more importantly, I am impressed with the amount of courage you displayed when you agreed to take this dangerous weapon without any hesitation. You deserve it. The #p1201001# is yours.
units.targetZh: “哦，你把#t4032311#带来了吗？你比我想象的要强大！但更重要的是，我对你在毫不犹豫地接下这件危险武器时所表现出的勇气印象深刻。你值得拥有它。#p1201001#是你的了。”

units.referenceText: Go for the 30 #t4032311#.

units.sourceText: #b(过了很长时间，#p1203000#把小心用布包着的#p1201001#递给了你。)
units.referenceText: #b(After a long time passed, #p1203000# handed you the #p1201001#, which was carefully wrapped in cloth.)
units.targetZh: #b(过了很长时间，#p1203000#把小心用布包着的#p1201001#递给了你。)

units.sourceText: 这是你要的长枪，编号#p1201002#。请好好保管。
units.referenceText: Here, this is #p1201002#, the Polearm you've asked for. Please take good care of it.
units.targetZh: 这是你要的长枪，编号#p1201002#。请好好保管。

units.referenceText: Please bring me the box with the supplies that lies with #b#p2012019##k...

units.sourceText: 噢，你居然带来了#p2012019#k，谢谢。
units.referenceText: Oh, you brought #p2012019#'s box! Thank you.
units.targetZh: 噢，你居然带来了#p2012019#k，谢谢。

units.referenceText: Please bring me the box with the supplies that lies with #b#p2012019##k...

units.sourceText: 噢，你居然带来了#p2012019#k，谢谢。
units.referenceText: Oh, you brought #p2012019#'s box! Thank you.
units.targetZh: 噢，你居然带来了#p2012019#k，谢谢。

units.sourceText: 我看你已经准备好接受任务了。那么，请注意任务的细节。。。
units.referenceText: I see you're ready for the task. Now, pay heed to the details of your mission...
units.targetZh: 我看你已经准备好接受任务了。那么，请注意任务的细节。。。

units.sourceText: #b(你需要考虑一下。。。)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You need to think about this for a second...)#k
units.targetZh: #b(你需要考虑一下。。。)#k

units.sourceText: 训练进行得如何？ 嗯... 70级...还不算什么，但是自从我第一次结识冰鲜面世以来，您确实取得了长足的进步。 继续训练，我相信有一天您将能够重新获得战斗前的状态。
units.referenceText: How's the training going? Hmmm... Level 70... That's still not much, but you have really made some strides since the first time I met you fresh out of ice. Keep training, and I am sure one day you'll be able to regain your pre-battle form.
units.targetZh: 训练进行得如何？ 嗯... 70级...还不算什么，但是自从我第一次结识冰鲜面世以来，您确实取得了长足的进步。 继续训练，我相信有一天您将能够重新获得战斗前的状态。

units.sourceText: 但在那之前，我需要你再控制一下。#我们的杆臂又一次做出奇怪的反应。好像有什么事要告诉你。#基特也许能唤醒你隐藏的力量，所以请马上来。
units.referenceText: But before doing that, I'll need you back in Rein for a bit. #bYour pole arm is reacting strange once again. It looks like it has something it wants to tell you. #kIt might be able to awaken your hidden powers, so please come immediately.
units.targetZh: 但在那之前，我需要你再控制一下。#我们的杆臂又一次做出奇怪的反应。好像有什么事要告诉你。#基特也许能唤醒你隐藏的力量，所以请马上来。

units.sourceText: 不管怎么说，我以为武器有自己的身份，但说真的。。。这武器不停地说话。它先是不停地哭，因为我没有真正注意到它的需要，然后。。。啊，请保守这个秘密。我不认为再打乱武器是个好主意。
units.referenceText: Anyway, I thought it was really something that a weapon has its own identity, but seriously... this weapon does not stop talking. It first kept on crying because I wasn't really paying attention to its needs, and... ahh, please keep this a secret from the pole arm. I don't think it's a good idea to upset the weapon any further.
units.targetZh: 不管怎么说，我以为武器有自己的身份，但说真的。。。这武器不停地说话。它先是不停地哭，因为我没有真正注意到它的需要，然后。。。啊，请保守这个秘密。我不认为再打乱武器是个好主意。

units.sourceText: #b(您需要考虑一下...)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You need to think about this for a second...)#k
units.targetZh: #b(您需要考虑一下...)#k

units.sourceText: 您已经成功杀死了 #o9001013# ？ 哈哈哈...你确实是我的主人。 好吧，现在给我您在那找到的红玉。 我必须把它放回身上，然后……等等，为什么你不说一句话？ 别告诉我...你没带回来!
units.referenceText: Did you manage to slay #o9001013#? Hahaha... you're my master, indeed. Okay, now give me the Red Jade that you found there. I'll have to put it back on the body, and... wait, why aren't you saying a word? Don't tell me... that you didn't bring that back!
units.targetZh: 您已经成功杀死了 #o9001013# ？ 哈哈哈...你确实是我的主人。 好吧，现在给我您在那找到的红玉。 我必须把它放回身上，然后……等等，为什么你不说一句话？ 别告诉我...你没带回来!

units.sourceText: 什么？！ 您真的没有带回《红玉》吗？ 为什么？ 您是否完全忘记了它？ 啊...即使受到黑魔法师的诅咒，以及过去的时间和所有的一切，我从来没有想过我的主人会变得愚蠢...
units.referenceText: What?! You really didn't bring back the Red Jade? Why? Did you just completely forget it? Ahh... even with the curse of the Black Mage, and the amount of time that has passed and all, never did I think my master would turn out to be stupid...
units.targetZh: 什么？！ 您真的没有带回《红玉》吗？ 为什么？ 您是否完全忘记了它？ 啊...即使受到黑魔法师的诅咒，以及过去的时间和所有的一切，我从来没有想过我的主人会变得愚蠢...

units.sourceText: 不，不，我不能让这让我感到绝望。 这是我应该保持镇定和控制的时候，不像我的主人... 努萨 ...
units.referenceText:
No, no, I can't let this put me in despair. This is when I should remain calm and in control, unlike my master...
oosah...
units.targetZh: 不，不，我不能让这让我感到绝望。 这是我应该保持镇定和控制的时候，不像我的主人... 努萨 ...

units.sourceText: 即使你现在回去，小偷也可能从那里逃走了。这意味着你得重新做红玉。你以前做过，所以你记得做一个的材料，对吧？现在走。。。
units.referenceText: Even if you go back there now, the thief probably made its way out of there. This means you'll have to make the Red Jade anew. You've made one before, so you do remember the materials required to make one, right? Now go...
units.targetZh: 即使你现在回去，小偷也可能从那里逃走了。这意味着你得重新做红玉。你以前做过，所以你记得做一个的材料，对吧？现在走。。。

units.sourceText: 这家伙肯定失去了所有的记忆!
units.referenceText: THIS GUY HAS DEFINITELY LOST ALL MEMORIES!
units.targetZh: 这家伙肯定失去了所有的记忆!

units.sourceText: …没有希望，没有梦想。。。不，不!!
units.referenceText: ...No hope, no dreams... Nooooo!!
units.targetZh: …没有希望，没有梦想。。。不，不!!

units.sourceText: #b(玛哈开始变得歇斯底里了。我最好马上离开。也许莉莉能做点什么.)
units.referenceText: #b(Maha is beginning to really get hysterical. I better leave right this minute. Maybe Lilin can do something about it.)
units.targetZh: #b(玛哈开始变得歇斯底里了。我最好马上离开。也许莉莉能做点什么.)

units.sourceText: 嘿！至少你试过了!
units.referenceText: Hey! At least say you tried!
units.targetZh: 嘿！至少你试过了!

units.sourceText:
等待。。是不是。。你记得怎么做红玉吗？
如何。。。你可能很愚蠢，容易健忘症，但这就是为什么我不能抛弃你。现在把玉给我!
units.referenceText:
Wait.. Isn't that.. Did you remember how to make Red Jade?
Wow... you may be stupid and prone to amnesia, but this is why I can't abandon you. Now give me the jade!
units.targetZh:
等待。。是不是。。你记得怎么做红玉吗？
如何。。。你可能很愚蠢，容易健忘症，但这就是为什么我不能抛弃你。现在把玉给我!

units.sourceText: 好吧，现在我又戴上了红玉，让我重新唤醒你更多的能力。我是说，自从我们上次见面以来，你的水平提高了很多，所以我相信这次我可以发挥我的魔力!
units.referenceText: Okay, now that I have the Red Jade back on, let me work on reawakening more of your abilities. I mean, your level's gone much higher since the last time we met, so I am sure I can work my magic a bit more this time!
units.targetZh: 好吧，现在我又戴上了红玉，让我重新唤醒你更多的能力。我是说，自从我们上次见面以来，你的水平提高了很多，所以我相信这次我可以发挥我的魔力!

units.sourceText: 哇，您的 #b装备#k 库存已满。 我需要您至少腾出1个空位才能完成此任务.
units.referenceText: Wow, your #bequip#k inventory is full. I need you to make at least 1 empty slot to complete this quest.
units.targetZh: 哇，您的 #b装备#k 库存已满。 我需要您至少腾出1个空位才能完成此任务.

units.sourceText: 来吧，继续训练，这样您就可以恢复自己的全部能力，这样我们就可以再次一起探索!
units.referenceText: Come on, keep training so you can get all your abilities back, and that way we can explore together once more!
units.targetZh: 来吧，继续训练，这样您就可以恢复自己的全部能力，这样我们就可以再次一起探索!

units.sourceText: 啊额... 雪人 #b#t4032339##k 刚刚被偷了! 多么令人沮丧, 雪人为了得到它而努力工作, 就为了让那只乌鸦偷走它。。。
units.referenceText: Aaaargh... Yeti's #b#t4032339##k has just been stolen! How frustrating, Yeti worked hard to get it, just to have it stolen by that #rThief Crow#k...
units.targetZh: 啊额... 雪人 #b#t4032339##k 刚刚被偷了! 多么令人沮丧, 雪人为了得到它而努力工作, 就为了让那只乌鸦偷走它。。。

units.sourceText: 嘿，我只是路过，不能不听到你刚才。我可以借给你我的力量，小偷去哪了?
units.referenceText: Hey, I was just passing by and could not refrain from hearing you just now. I can lend you my strength, where did the thief go?
units.targetZh: 嘿，我只是路过，不能不听到你刚才。我可以借给你我的力量，小偷去哪了?

units.sourceText: 哦，你真好。。。小偷从西边的门前走过，把#i4032339##k 拿回来，雪人需要它送给心爱的人.
units.referenceText: Oh, how nice of you... Thief has passed #rthrough the gate at west#k. Bring back the #b#t4032339##k, Yeti needs it to give to beloved one.
units.targetZh: 哦，你真好。。。小偷从西边的门前走过，把#i4032339##k 拿回来，雪人需要它送给心爱的人.

units.sourceText: 好的，在那儿等着。我马上还给你!
units.referenceText: Ok, wait there. I will return it back to you in no time!
units.targetZh: 好的，在那儿等着。我马上还给你!

units.sourceText: #b(你得考虑一下...)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You need to think about this for a second...)#k
units.targetZh: #b(你得考虑一下...)#k

units.sourceText: 训练进展如何？我知道你很忙，但是请立即过来#b里恩#k.摩诃开始变得怪异了.和以前不一样了。是。。。比平时更黑。
units.referenceText: How is the training going? I know you're busy, but please come to #bRien#k immediately. The #bMaha#k has started to act weird again... But its even weirder now. It's different from before. It's... darker than usual.
units.targetZh: 训练进展如何？我知道你很忙，但是请立即过来#b里恩#k.摩诃开始变得怪异了.和以前不一样了。是。。。比平时更黑。

units.sourceText: 我对此有种不好的感觉。请回来。我从来没有见过这样的马哈，但我能感觉到它所经历的痛苦。#b只有你，摩诃的主人，才能做点什么!
units.referenceText: I have a bad feeling about this. Please come back here. I've never seen or herd Maha like this, but I can sense the suffering its going through. #bOnly you, the master of Maha, can do something about it!
units.targetZh: 我对此有种不好的感觉。请回来。我从来没有见过这样的马哈，但我能感觉到它所经历的痛苦。#b只有你，摩诃的主人，才能做点什么!

units.sourceText: #b(你需要考虑一下。。。)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You need to think about this for a second...)#k
units.targetZh: #b(你需要考虑一下。。。)#k

units.sourceText: 你问我，为什么我看起来像这样？我不想谈这个，但我想我不能对你隐瞒，因为你是我的主人.
units.referenceText: Why do I look like this, you ask? I don't want to talk about it, but I suppose I can't hide from you since you're my master.
units.targetZh: 你问我，为什么我看起来像这样？我不想谈这个，但我想我不能对你隐瞒，因为你是我的主人.

units.sourceText: 当你被困在冰里几百年的时候，我也被冻住了。离开你很久了。就在那时，黑暗的种子种在了我的心里.
units.referenceText: While you were trapped inside ice for hundreds of years, I, too, was frozen. It was a long time to be away from you. That's when the seed of darkness was planted in my heart.
units.targetZh: 当你被困在冰里几百年的时候，我也被冻住了。离开你很久了。就在那时，黑暗的种子种在了我的心里.

units.sourceText: 但自从你醒来，我以为黑暗已经消失了。我以为事情会回到原来的样子。但我错了。。。
units.referenceText: But since you awoke, I thought the darkness had gone away. I thought things would return to the way they were. But I was mistaken...
units.targetZh: 但自从你醒来，我以为黑暗已经消失了。我以为事情会回到原来的样子。但我错了。。。

units.sourceText: 拜托，战神。请阻止我发火。只有你能控制我。它现在从我手中消失了。请不惜一切代价#r别让我发疯#k!
units.referenceText: Please, Aran. Please stop me from becoming enraged. Only you can control me. It's getting out of my hands now. Please do whatever it takes to #rstop me from going berserk#k!
units.targetZh: 拜托，战神。请阻止我发火。只有你能控制我。它现在从我手中消失了。请不惜一切代价#r别让我发疯#k!

units.sourceText: 地图上有人，请稍后再来.
units.referenceText: There is currently someone in this map, come back later.
units.targetZh: 地图上有人，请稍后再来.

units.sourceText: #b(你需要考虑一下……)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You need to think about this for a second...)#k
units.targetZh: #b(你需要考虑一下……)#k

units.sourceText: 谢谢你，战神。如果不是你，我会很生气，谁知道会发生什么。谢谢你，不要！这只是你作为我主人的职责。。。
units.referenceText: Thank you, Aran. If it weren't for you, I would have become enraged and who knows what could have happened. Thank you, NOT! It's only your duty as my master...
units.targetZh: 谢谢你，战神。如果不是你，我会很生气，谁知道会发生什么。谢谢你，不要！这只是你作为我主人的职责。。。

units.sourceText: 不管怎样，我只是注意到你达到了一个多么高的水平。如果你能控制我的愤怒，我想你已经准备好处理更多的能力了.
units.referenceText: Anyway, I just noticed how high of a level you've reached. If you were able to control me in my state of rage, I think you're ready to handle more abilities.
units.targetZh: 不管怎样，我只是注意到你达到了一个多么高的水平。如果你能控制我的愤怒，我想你已经准备好处理更多的能力了.

units.sourceText: 哇，你的#b装备栏#k已满. 请留出多余的空间来获取物品.
units.referenceText: Wow, your #bequip#k inventory is full. I need you to make at least 1 empty slot to complete this quest.
units.targetZh: 哇，你的#b装备栏#k已满. 请留出多余的空间来获取物品.

units.sourceText: 你的#b物品栏#k已满. 请留出多余的空间来获取物品.
units.referenceText: Hey, your #buse#k inventory is full. I need you to make at least 1 empty slot to complete this quest.
units.targetZh: 你的#b物品栏#k已满. 请留出多余的空间来获取物品.

units.sourceText: 你的技能已经恢复。这些技能已经沉睡了很长时间，你必须重新训练自己，但一旦你完成训练，你就会和以前一样.
units.referenceText: Your skills have been restored. Those skills have been dormant for so long that you'll have to re-train yourself, but you'll be as good as new once you complete your training.
units.targetZh: 你的技能已经恢复。这些技能已经沉睡了很长时间，你必须重新训练自己，但一旦你完成训练，你就会和以前一样.

units.sourceText: 无论这鬼树走到哪里，似乎都有蝙蝠陪伴着它。令人毛骨悚然。
units.referenceText: Some bats seems to accompany this tree wherever it goes. Creepy...
units.targetZh: 无论这鬼树走到哪里，似乎都有蝙蝠陪伴着它。令人毛骨悚然。

units.sourceText: 据说每当有什么邪恶的东西扰乱这片土地时，一棵鬼树就会出现在这里。。。我们需要一个能保护我们村子的英雄！
units.referenceText: It is said that a old tree gets alive whenever something sinister disturbs this land... We need a hero that fends our village of that creature!
units.targetZh: 据说每当有什么邪恶的东西扰乱这片土地时，一棵鬼树就会出现在这里。。。我们需要一个能保护我们村子的英雄！

units.sourceText: 我告诉你，这棵树的树枝上有一条围巾。
units.referenceText: The tree has a scarf upon its branches, I tell you.
units.targetZh: 我告诉你，这棵树的树枝上有一条围巾。

units.sourceText: 这棵树有一个奇怪的雕刻，像一张吓人的脸。
units.referenceText: The tree has a strange carving that resembles a scary face.
units.targetZh: 这棵树有一个奇怪的雕刻，像一张吓人的脸。

units.sourceText: 那棵树。。。我以前听说过，我甚至研究过它的行为！如果我没记错，在某些条件下它会复活，开始吸取这些可怕的邪恶力量，这使得它们对附近的人和村子造成非常可怕的影响。
units.referenceText: That tree... I've heard of it before, I even studied its behavior! If I recall correctly, the #bStumpy#k comes alive when the soil deems infertile by some sort of magic, and those stumps who evolves under these conditions starts to drain these suspicious magical sources instead of water and minerals for living, which makes them very threathening to people and villages nearby.
units.targetZh: 那棵树。。。我以前听说过，我甚至研究过它的行为！如果我没记错，在某些条件下它会复活，开始吸取这些可怕的邪恶力量，这使得它们对附近的人和村子造成非常可怕的影响。

units.sourceText: 嘿，战神。你看起来很强壮，从你从冰川中解脱出来的那一刻起。现在我将送给你一只坐骑。。
units.referenceText: Hey, Aran. You seem pretty strong, since that time from when you got freed from the glacier. Suitable enough to #bride a wolf#k, if you ask me.
units.targetZh: 嘿，战神。你看起来很强壮，从你从冰川中解脱出来的那一刻起。现在我将送给你一只坐骑。。

units.sourceText: 选择了你的兴趣，嗯？很好，首先你必须去巴夸，那里有一个人给狼崽做食物，给我带一份来，我相信你能驯服和照顾一份。你说什么，你能试试吗?
units.referenceText: Picked your interest, huh? Very well, first you must make your way to #bAqua#k, there is a person there who makes #rfood for wolf cubs#k. Bring one portion to me, and I shall deem you able to tame and take care of one. What do you say, will you try for it?
units.targetZh: 选择了你的兴趣，嗯？很好，首先你必须去巴夸，那里有一个人给狼崽做食物，给我带一份来，我相信你能驯服和照顾一份。你说什么，你能试试吗?

units.sourceText: 好吧。你一定要遇见的是一头蓝鲸，她在海底世界的某个地方，一头蓝鲸的顶上。祝你好运！
units.referenceText: Alright. The one you must meet is #bNanuke#k, she is on top of a #rsnowy whale#k, somewhere in the ocean. Good luck!
units.targetZh: 好吧。你一定要遇见的是一头蓝鲸，她在海底世界的某个地方，一头蓝鲸的顶上。祝你好运！

units.sourceText: 你想用狼当坐骑，但你没有狼鞍？为什么，我有很好的解决方案给你！先到这里来，我会教你怎么骑狼.
units.referenceText: You want to use a Wolf as a mount, but you don't have a #bWolf saddle#k? Why, I have just the fine solution for you! Come here in #bEl Nath#k first, I shall teach you how to mount a wolf as an extra.
units.targetZh: 你想用狼当坐骑，但你没有狼鞍？为什么，我有很好的解决方案给你！先到这里来，我会教你怎么骑狼.

units.sourceText: 到这里，去找 #r50 #t4000048##k 然后把它们带给我.
units.referenceText: Once here, hunt for #r50 #t4000048##k then bring them to me.
units.targetZh: 到这里，去找 #r50 #t4000048##k 然后把它们带给我.

units.sourceText: 我们是一群狼在寻找我们丢失的孩子。我听说你在照顾我们的孩子。我们很感激你的好意，但现在是时候把孩子还给我们了.
units.referenceText: We're a pack of wolves looking for our lost child. I hear you are taking care of our baby. We appreciate your kindness, but it's time to return our baby to us.
units.targetZh: 我们是一群狼在寻找我们丢失的孩子。我听说你在照顾我们的孩子。我们很感激你的好意，但现在是时候把孩子还给我们了.

units.sourceText: 狼人也是我的朋友，我不能只认识人类朋友.
units.referenceText: Werewolf is my friend, I can't just hand over a friend.
units.targetZh: 狼人也是我的朋友，我不能只认识人类朋友.

units.sourceText: 我们明白，但我们不会离开我们的小狗。告诉你吧，我们会测试你是否值得养狼。#准备被狼测试的小目标.#k
units.referenceText: We understand, but we won't leave without our pup. Tell you what, we'll test you to see if you are worthy of raising a wolf. #rGet ready to be tested by wolves.#k
units.targetZh: 我们明白，但我们不会离开我们的小狗。告诉你吧，我们会测试你是否值得养狼。#准备被狼测试的小目标.#k

units.sourceText: 抱歉，第三个登山任务（狼群）已经关闭.
units.referenceText: Sorry, but the 3rd mount quest (Wolves) is closed.
units.targetZh: 抱歉，第三个登山任务（狼群）已经关闭.

units.sourceText: 地图里已经有人了，请稍后再来.
units.referenceText: There is currently someone in this map, come back later.
units.targetZh: 地图里已经有人了，请稍后再来.

units.sourceText: 哦，这只你的狼朋友。。。你看，我感觉到他皮毛背后隐藏着某种力量。等等，主人，如果我醒来，那是隐藏的力量?
units.referenceText: Oh, this befriended wolf of yours... I sense some hidden powers hidden behind his furs, you see. Wat'cha say, master, if I awaken it's hidden power?
units.targetZh: 哦，这只你的狼朋友。。。你看，我感觉到他皮毛背后隐藏着某种力量。等等，主人，如果我醒来，那是隐藏的力量?

units.sourceText: 等等，你能做到吗?
units.referenceText: Wait, can you do that?
units.targetZh: 等等，你能做到吗?

units.sourceText: 很惊讶吧？冰河中冰冻的时间是否也妨碍了你的感官？当然，为什么！准备好了告诉我!
units.referenceText: Astonished, huh? Does all that time frozen in the glacier hindered your senses as well? Why, of course! Tell me when you're ready!
units.targetZh: 很惊讶吧？冰河中冰冻的时间是否也妨碍了你的感官？当然，为什么！准备好了告诉我!

units.sourceText: 在开始进化之前，你必须先解开狼的尾巴.
units.referenceText: You will have to unequip the wolf first before going for the evolution.
units.targetZh: 在开始进化之前，你必须先解开狼的尾巴.

units.sourceText: 让开，瞧瞧，玛哈的威力!!
units.referenceText: Step aside, behold the mighty prowess of Maha!!
units.targetZh: 让开，瞧瞧，玛哈的威力!!

units.sourceText: 不？你是说你可以自己训练吗？我只是想告诉你，如果你和教练一起训练，你会得到更好的成绩。你不能一个人生活在这个世界上。你必须学会和别人相处.
units.referenceText: No? Are you saying you can train on your own? I'm just letting you know that you'll get better results if you train with an instructor. You can't live in this world alone. You must learn to get along with other people.
units.targetZh: 不？你是说你可以自己训练吗？我只是想告诉你，如果你和教练一起训练，你会得到更好的成绩。你不能一个人生活在这个世界上。你必须学会和别人相处.

units.sourceText: 你似乎在回想什么。这个长矛果然认出了你。那么你肯定就是#b使用长矛的英雄，战神#k了。你想起什么其他的了吗？有关长矛的技能之类......
units.referenceText: It seems like you've started to remember things. Your Polearm must have recognized you. This means you are surely #bAran, the wielder of Polearms#k. Is there anything else you remember? Skills you used with the Polearm perhaps? Anything?
units.targetZh: 你似乎在回想什么。这个长矛果然认出了你。那么你肯定就是#b使用长矛的英雄，战神#k了。你想起什么其他的了吗？有关长矛的技能之类......

units.sourceText: #b（说技能倒是想起来了几个。）#k
units.referenceText: #b(You tell her that you remember a few skills.)#k
units.targetZh: #b（说技能倒是想起来了几个。）#k

units.sourceText: 虽然数量不多，不过也已经很不容易了。现在让我们集中精力来恢复过去的技能吧。虽然你失忆了，但毕竟是以前曾经烂熟于心的东西，要恢复起来应该很快。
units.referenceText: That's not a lot, but it's progress. Our focus, then, should be to get you back to the state before you were frozen. You may have lost your memory, but I'm sure it won't take long for you to recover the abilities that your body remembers.
units.targetZh: 虽然数量不多，不过也已经很不容易了。现在让我们集中精力来恢复过去的技能吧。虽然你失忆了，但毕竟是以前曾经烂熟于心的东西，要恢复起来应该很快。

units.sourceText: 怎么恢复过去的技能？
units.referenceText: How do I recover my abilities?
units.targetZh: 怎么恢复过去的技能？

units.sourceText: 那个......办法只有一个。就是修炼！修炼！修炼！只有不停地修炼才能找回曾经忘却的身体感觉！
units.referenceText: There is only one way to do that. Train! Train! Train! Train! If you continue to train, your body will instinctively remember its abilities. To help you through the process, I'll introduce you to an instructor.
units.targetZh: 那个......办法只有一个。就是修炼！修炼！修炼！只有不停地修炼才能找回曾经忘却的身体感觉！

units.sourceText: 武器要是能使得更熟练就好了。送你一支#b长矛#k，希望你在修炼的时候能够进步得更快。带着这支长矛......
units.referenceText: I gave you a #bPolearm#k because I figured it would be best for you to use a weapon you're familiar with. It will be useful in your training.
units.targetZh: 武器要是能使得更熟练就好了。送你一支#b长矛#k，希望你在修炼的时候能够进步得更快。带着这支长矛......

units.sourceText: 如果你离开这里，从村子的左边出去，在里恩修炼场入口可以见到长期研究英雄技能的#b#p1202006##k，让他来帮助你。
units.referenceText: You'll find a Training Center if you exit to the #bleft#k. There, you'll meet #b#p1202006##k. I'm a bit worried because I think he may be struggling with bouts of Alzheimer's, but he spent a long time researching skills to help you. I'm sure you'll learn a thing or two from him.
units.targetZh: 如果你离开这里，从村子的左边出去，在里恩修炼场入口可以见到长期研究英雄技能的#b#p1202006##k，让他来帮助你。

units.sourceText: 请完成属性的分配。
units.targetZh: 请完成属性的分配。

units.sourceText: 看来你已经完成属性的分配了，让我们开始真正的修炼吧。
units.targetZh: 看来你已经完成属性的分配了，让我们开始真正的修炼吧。

units.sourceText: 我知道要超越你的教练需要极大的力量和意志，但你并不是能让自己颓废。你必须朝着更大更好的方向前进！你必须尽你所能去拥抱你的英雄本性!
units.referenceText: I know it takes an incredible amount of strength and will to outdo your instructor, but you weren't meant to let yourself wither away. You must move on to bigger and better things! You must do everything you can to embrace your heroic nature!
units.targetZh: 我知道要超越你的教练需要极大的力量和意志，但你并不是能让自己颓废。你必须朝着更大更好的方向前进！你必须尽你所能去拥抱你的英雄本性!

units.sourceText: ……现在你的能力是什么程度，我大概了解了……呵呵……没想到我这把老骨头还能有今天……真是感动得要流眼泪……不，是鼻涕……
units.referenceText: Your abilities are really beginning to take shape. I am surprised that an old man like me was able to help you. I'm tearing up just thinking about how happy it makes me to have been of assistance to you. *Sniff sniff*
units.targetZh: ……现在你的能力是什么程度，我大概了解了……呵呵……没想到我这把老骨头还能有今天……真是感动得要流眼泪……不，是鼻涕……

units.sourceText: #b(……也没怎么修炼嘛……?)#k
units.referenceText: #b(You didn't even train that long with him... Why is he crying?)#k
units.targetZh: #b(……也没怎么修炼嘛……?)#k

units.sourceText: 好，现在让我们开始第3阶段的最后一阶段的锻炼。这次修炼的对象是……#r#o9300343##k！猪猪！你了解他们吗?
units.referenceText: Alright, here's the third and the final stage of training. Your last opponent is... #r#o9300343#s#k! Do you know anything about #o1210100#s?
units.targetZh: 好，现在让我们开始第3阶段的最后一阶段的锻炼。这次修炼的对象是……#r#o9300343##k！猪猪！你了解他们吗?

units.sourceText: 一点点……
units.referenceText: Well, a little bit...
units.targetZh: 一点点……

units.sourceText: 他们是天生的战士！从出生的那一刻起，对食物就充满了无穷的愤怒，凡是他们经过的地方都不会留下任何食物。很可怕吧?
units.referenceText: They are natural warriors! They're born with a voracious appetite for food. They devour any food that's visible the moment they sweep by. Terrifying, isn't it?
units.targetZh: 他们是天生的战士！从出生的那一刻起，对食物就充满了无穷的愤怒，凡是他们经过的地方都不会留下任何食物。很可怕吧?

units.sourceText: #b(他不是在开玩笑吧?)#k
units.referenceText: #b(Is that really true?)#k
units.targetZh: #b(他不是在开玩笑吧?)#k

units.sourceText: 来，快点#b再次进入修炼场#k，去和那些天生的战士们修炼用的猪中战斗吧，打倒#r30只#k后，你的能力将会有一个质的飞跃。全力以赴地去战斗吧！超越我这个教练！
units.referenceText: Okay, now... #bEnter the Training Center again#k, defeat #r30#k #o9300343#s, and show me what you're made of! You'll have to exert all your energy to defeat them! Go, go, go! Rise above me!
units.targetZh: 来，快点#b再次进入修炼场#k，去和那些天生的战士们修炼用的猪中战斗吧，打倒#r30只#k后，你的能力将会有一个质的飞跃。全力以赴地去战斗吧！超越我这个教练！

units.sourceText: 快走吧！去打倒那些#o9300343#!
units.referenceText: Now go and take on those monstrous #o9300343#s!
units.targetZh: 快走吧！去打倒那些#o9300343#!

units.sourceText: 你是不舍得离开我这个老头子吗？*抽泣* 我真的很感动，但你不能在这里停下脚步。你注定要成就更伟大的事业！
units.referenceText: Are you reluctant to leave your instructor? *Sniff sniff* I'm so moved, but you can't stop here. You are destined for bigger and better things!
units.targetZh: 你是不舍得离开我这个老头子吗？*抽泣* 我真的很感动，但你不能在这里停下脚步。你注定要成就更伟大的事业！

units.sourceText: 这么快就打倒了30只#o9300343#……我这老头子果然没有看错。虽然你失去了曾经的记忆，失去了曾经的能力，但你仍然是个英雄！只要手上的长矛还在！
units.referenceText: Ah, you've come back after defeating all 30 #o9300343#s. I knew you had it in you... Even though you have no memories and few abilities, I could see that you were different! How? Because you're carrying around a Polearm, obviously!
units.targetZh: 这么快就打倒了30只#o9300343#……我这老头子果然没有看错。虽然你失去了曾经的记忆，失去了曾经的能力，但你仍然是个英雄！只要手上的长矛还在！

units.sourceText: #b(这么说是为了安慰我吗？)#k
units.referenceText: #b(Is he pulling your leg?)#k'
units.targetZh: #b(这么说是为了安慰我吗？)#k

units.sourceText: 我已经没什么可继续教你的了。你已经超越了我这个老头子。你可以下山了……唉，没什么好忧郁的。我这老头子能够有机会指导你，已经很满足了。
units.referenceText: I have nothing more to teach you, as you've surpassed my level of skill. Go now! Don't look back! This old man is happy to have served as your instructor.
units.targetZh: 我已经没什么可继续教你的了。你已经超越了我这个老头子。你可以下山了……唉，没什么好忧郁的。我这老头子能够有机会指导你，已经很满足了。

units.sourceText: (我想起了技能#b连击能力#k！ 我还想跟着有点痴呆的老头子训练有没有效果呢，没想到真的有效！)
units.referenceText: (You remembered the #bCombo Ability#k skill! You were skeptical of the training at first, since the old man suffers from Alzheimer's and all, but boy, was it effective!)
units.targetZh: (我想起了技能#b连击能力#k！ 我还想跟着有点痴呆的老头子训练有没有效果呢，没想到真的有效！)

units.sourceText: 现在你回去找#p1201000#吧。她看到你的进步会很高兴的！
units.referenceText: Now report back to #p1201000#. I know she'll be ecstatic when she sees the progress you've made!
units.targetZh: 现在你回去找#p1201000#吧。她看到你的进步会很高兴的！

units.sourceText: 修炼进行的不错吧？#p1202006#个性很强……他对战神的技能确实很有研究，对你应该能帮上不少忙。
units.referenceText: How did the training go? The Penguin Teacher #p1202006# likes to exaggerate and it worried me knowing that he has bouts of Alzheimer's, but I'm sure he helped you. He's been studying the skills of heroes for a very long time.
units.targetZh: 修炼进行的不错吧？#p1202006#个性很强……他对战神的技能确实很有研究，对你应该能帮上不少忙。

units.sourceText: #b（告诉他自己回想起来连击能力这个技能。）#k
units.referenceText: #b(You tell her that you were able to remember the Combo Ability skill.)#k
units.targetZh: #b（告诉他自己回想起来连击能力这个技能。）#k

units.sourceText:
是吗！看来除了#p1202006#的训练方式之外，你自己仍然记的从前的那些技能也很关键啊……看来只是在这里冰冻的太久，需要时间恢复而已。#b继续加油训练吧，争取早日恢复所有的技能！ 

#fUI/UIWindow.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 500 exp
units.referenceText:
That's great! Honestly, though, I think it has less to do with the method of #p1202006#'s training and more to do with your body remembering its old abilities. #bI'm sure your body will remember more skills as you continue to train#k!  

#fUI/UIWindow.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 500 exp
units.targetZh:
是吗！看来除了#p1202006#的训练方式之外，你自己仍然记的从前的那些技能也很关键啊……看来只是在这里冰冻的太久，需要时间恢复而已。#b继续加油训练吧，争取早日恢复所有的技能！ 

#fUI/UIWindow.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 500 exp

units.sourceText: 你还是不明白怎么回事？如果你再跟我说一次，我再跟你解释一遍。
units.referenceText: You still don't understand what's going on? I'll explain it to you again if you talk to me one more time.
units.targetZh: 你还是不明白怎么回事？如果你再跟我说一次，我再跟你解释一遍。

units.sourceText: #t4032315#总是会#b发出奇怪的声音#k。当然，你是听不见的。因为那是只有#o1210102#才能听到的声音。在这种声音的影响下，#o1210102#的性格似乎发生了变化。
units.referenceText: #t4032315#... #rThis puppet is making a strange noise#k. You can't hear it with your ears, of course, since it can only be heard by the #o1210102#s. I believe it's this noise that changed the personality of the #o1210102#s.
units.targetZh: #t4032315#总是会#b发出奇怪的声音#k。当然，你是听不见的。因为那是只有#o1210102#才能听到的声音。在这种声音的影响下，#o1210102#的性格似乎发生了变化。

units.sourceText: 性格变得怪异的#o1210102#开始和没有发生变化的#o1210102#战斗，这导致射手村附近的#o1210102#全部变得残暴起来了。#b使得最近怪物们发生了变化的根源就是这个人偶！#k你明白了吧？
units.referenceText: The #o1210102#s that have been affected by the noise have turned cynical. They've started fighting the non-affected #o1210102#s, which has made all #o1210102#s prepare for combat. #bThe reason for all these changes in the #o1210102#s is this puppet#k! Do you understand?
units.targetZh: 性格变得怪异的#o1210102#开始和没有发生变化的#o1210102#战斗，这导致射手村附近的#o1210102#全部变得残暴起来了。#b使得最近怪物们发生了变化的根源就是这个人偶！#k你明白了吧？

units.sourceText: 怎么会发生这种事情呢......这种人偶不可能是自然形成的，一定是有人故意而为......看来要对#o1210102#的状态观察一段时间了。
units.referenceText: I wonder what triggered this in the first place. There is no way this puppet was naturally created, which means someone planned this. I should keep an eye on the #o1210102#s.
units.targetZh: 怎么会发生这种事情呢......这种人偶不可能是自然形成的，一定是有人故意而为......看来要对#o1210102#的状态观察一段时间了。

units.sourceText: #b（射手村周边的#o1210102#发生变化的原因找到了。现在把搜集到的信息告诉#p1002104#吧。）#k
units.referenceText: #b(You were able to find out what caused the changes in the #o1210102#s. You should report to #p1002104# and deliver the information you've gathered.)#k
units.targetZh: #b（射手村周边的#o1210102#发生变化的原因找到了。现在把搜集到的信息告诉#p1002104#吧。）#k

units.sourceText: 什么？我想除了那个孩子没有其他嫌疑犯。请再想想.
units.referenceText: What? I don't think there are any suspects besides that kid. Please think again.
units.targetZh: 什么？我想除了那个孩子没有其他嫌疑犯。请再想想.

units.referenceText: What did #p1032112# say?

units.sourceText: #b（“#p1032112#”告诉我，不久前，有个奇怪的孩子来到这里，那个孩子手上好像拿着人偶。好像从那之后魔法森林中就出现了奇怪的怪物......）#k
units.referenceText: #b(You tell her what #p1032112# observed.)#k
units.targetZh: #b（“#p1032112#”告诉我，不久前，有个奇怪的孩子来到这里，那个孩子手上好像拿着人偶。好像从那之后魔法森林中就出现了奇怪的怪物......）#k

units.sourceText: 吼...抱着人偶的小孩...不得不叫人怀疑。是有人故意把怪物变成为凶暴的证据啊...
units.referenceText: A kid with a puppet? That seems very suspicious. I am sure that kid is the reason the Green Mushrooms have suddenly turned violent.
units.targetZh: 吼...抱着人偶的小孩...不得不叫人怀疑。是有人故意把怪物变成为凶暴的证据啊...

units.sourceText: 魔法森林的和平已经被打破......这种恶行绝对不能饶恕......看来我得提醒村民们最近一定要多加小心。
units.referenceText: How dare this kid wreak havoc in the South Forest. Who knows how long it will take to restore the forest... I'll have to devote most of my time cleaning up the mess.
units.targetZh: 魔法森林的和平已经被打破......这种恶行绝对不能饶恕......看来我得提醒村民们最近一定要多加小心。

units.sourceText: #b（不过话说回来，村庄的人们真的有办法应对残暴的绿蘑菇吗？应该会很辛苦的说...既然找出引起绿蘑菇暴走的原因，现在把搜集到的情报告诉#p1002104#吧。）#k
units.referenceText: #b(You were able to find out what caused the changes in the Green Mushrooms. You should report #p1002104# and deliver the information you've collected.)#k
units.targetZh: #b（不过话说回来，村庄的人们真的有办法应对残暴的绿蘑菇吗？应该会很辛苦的说...既然找出引起绿蘑菇暴走的原因，现在把搜集到的情报告诉#p1002104#吧。）#k

units.sourceText: 莫非你是前不久在#m101000000#的那个人？终于找到你了！我找你找得好辛苦，知道吗？
units.referenceText: Aren't you the one that used to be in #m101000000# until not too long ago? I finally found you! Do you know how long it took for me to finally find you?
units.targetZh: 莫非你是前不久在#m101000000#的那个人？终于找到你了！我找你找得好辛苦，知道吗？

units.sourceText: 你是谁？
units.referenceText: Who are you?
units.targetZh: 你是谁？

units.sourceText: 我？你想知道的话就来我的洞窟吧。我想好好招待你一番。点击接受按钮就能立刻移动到我家。我在那里等你。
units.referenceText: Me? If you want to know, stop by my cave. I'll even send you an invitation. You'll be directly sent to my cave as soon as you accept. Look forward to seeing you there.
units.targetZh: 我？你想知道的话就来我的洞窟吧。我想好好招待你一番。点击接受按钮就能立刻移动到我家。我在那里等你。

units.sourceText: 有什么事吗？你不是一直在金银岛上修炼吗？真相叔叔还带口信说你帮了大忙了。......什么？黑色之翼？
units.referenceText: What can I do for you? Tru sent me a message saying that you've been training diligently in Victoria Island while helping him with his work. What is it? What? The Black Wings?
units.targetZh: 有什么事吗？你不是一直在金银岛上修炼吗？真相叔叔还带口信说你帮了大忙了。......什么？黑色之翼？

units.sourceText: #b（讲述有关人偶师、黑色之翼，以及黑色之翼的目的事情。）#k
units.referenceText: #b(You tell her about the Puppeteer and the Black Wings, and about their mission.)#k
units.targetZh: #b（讲述有关人偶师、黑色之翼，以及黑色之翼的目的事情。）#k

units.sourceText: 原来是这样......叫黑色之翼啊。居然还有这么一帮人......明知很危险也要在冒险岛世界里复活黑魔法师，太不像话了。
units.referenceText: I see... I didn't know there was a group called the Black Wings... They must be fools if they're trying to revive the Black Mage, knowing how dangerous he is.
units.targetZh: 原来是这样......叫黑色之翼啊。居然还有这么一帮人......明知很危险也要在冒险岛世界里复活黑魔法师，太不像话了。

units.sourceText: 是，是啊......#b（他的语气突然变得很决断，好可怕。）#k
units.referenceText: That...that's true...#b(She's definitely not afraid to speak her mind.)#k
units.targetZh: 是，是啊......#b（他的语气突然变得很决断，好可怕。）#k

units.sourceText: 预言里只说到英雄会苏醒，与黑魔法师战斗。但我还一直半信半疑，这下我才明白黑魔法师是真的存在的。
units.referenceText: The Book of Prophecy states that the hero will revive and fight against the Black Mage. I wasn't sure if that was true, but this confirms that the Black Mage is still around.
units.targetZh: 预言里只说到英雄会苏醒，与黑魔法师战斗。但我还一直半信半疑，这下我才明白黑魔法师是真的存在的。

units.sourceText: 是不是很可怕？
units.referenceText: Aren't you scared?
units.targetZh: 是不是很可怕？

units.sourceText: 有什么可怕的？管他是什么黑魔法师还是什么别的，你都会将他们一一打倒的，还有什么好担心的呢？我们只会觉得斗志更加高涨。啊，对了，我发现了这个#b技能#k......看一眼吗？
units.referenceText: Scared? Pfft. Who cares if the Black Mage appears. You'll be here to protect us. If anything, this makes me want to prepare you for the big battle. Ah, that reminds me, I found a #bskill#k. Would you like to see it?
units.targetZh: 有什么可怕的？管他是什么黑魔法师还是什么别的，你都会将他们一一打倒的，还有什么好担心的呢？我们只会觉得斗志更加高涨。啊，对了，我发现了这个#b技能#k......看一眼吗？

units.sourceText: #b（你还记得快速矛的技能！）#k
units.referenceText: #b(You remembered the Polearm Booster skill!)#k
units.targetZh: #b（你还记得快速矛的技能！）#k

units.sourceText: 这个技能是在一个古老的神秘书籍中发现的。我有预感这可能是你过去用过的一种技能，我想我是对的。
units.referenceText: This skill was found in an ancient incomprehensible script. I had a hunch it might be a skill you used in the past, and I think I was right. You're not as strong as you used to be, but you'll get there, in time.
units.targetZh: 这个技能是在一个古老的神秘书籍中发现的。我有预感这可能是你过去用过的一种技能，我想我是对的。

units.sourceText: 你正在渐渐地变得强大起来。我会让你强大起来而倾尽全力帮助你的。有什么好害怕的呢？千万不能退缩。我们为了打败黑魔法师不是已经等待了数百年了吗？这次一定会取得胜利的！
units.referenceText: You are steadily becoming more powerful, and I'll be here to keep motivating you. You have nothing to be afraid of. You will not lose the battle. You didn't emerge from ice only to lose to the Black Mage, did you? This time, you'll finish him, once and for all!
units.targetZh: 你正在渐渐地变得强大起来。我会让你强大起来而倾尽全力帮助你的。有什么好害怕的呢？千万不能退缩。我们为了打败黑魔法师不是已经等待了数百年了吗？这次一定会取得胜利的！

units.sourceText: 呐，为了这个目标必须继续修炼！修炼明白吗？前往金银岛继续修炼吧。一定要练到能打败黑魔法师的程度才行！
units.referenceText: To do so, there's only one thing you can do. Train, train, train. Head to Victoria Island and continue training. Let's make sure you become so powerful that the Black Mage doesn't stand a chance!
units.targetZh: 呐，为了这个目标必须继续修炼！修炼明白吗？前往金银岛继续修炼吧。一定要练到能打败黑魔法师的程度才行！

units.sourceText: 好吧，你不必再回去找#b特鲁#k打听下一步该怎么做了。……等等！！我想起一件事。看到那边那座#r神秘雕像#k了吗？那座雕像来历不明，上面还刻着些什么，看起来很不得了，说不定就是洞窟的密码？#r去那里取得密码#k，也许对你的旅途会有帮助。
units.referenceText: Okay, you should not return to #bTru#k for further details on your next steps. ... Oh wait!! I remembered something. See the #rMysterious Statue#k over there? That statue has it's origins unknwown, and there's something scribbled onto it that resembles something big, it probably is the password for the cave? #rGet the password there#k, it may help you on your journey.
units.targetZh: 好吧，你不必再回去找#b特鲁#k打听下一步该怎么做了。……等等！！我想起一件事。看到那边那座#r神秘雕像#k了吗？那座雕像来历不明，上面还刻着些什么，看起来很不得了，说不定就是洞窟的密码？#r去那里取得密码#k，也许对你的旅途会有帮助。

units.sourceText:
喂，你在哪呢？大事不好了！你快来趟特鲁的情报商店！
（喂......？ 特鲁可是一直喊我英雄的......）
units.referenceText: Aran, Lith have been caught off guard. We are under attack! Get here ASAP.
units.targetZh:
喂，你在哪呢？大事不好了！你快来趟特鲁的情报商店！
（喂......？ 特鲁可是一直喊我英雄的......）

units.sourceText: 啊......没想到还会碰上这种事情。怎么都没想到人偶师还会潜伏到这里来。平时大概是疏于修炼了，完全被对方给算计了。不过，这也暴露出了他们的弱点。
units.referenceText: Aran, thank you very much! Somehow the Puppeteer managed to bypass the security of Lith Harbor. He was trying to seek revenge because of the other day. Luckily, you came by. Nicely done!
units.targetZh: 啊......没想到还会碰上这种事情。怎么都没想到人偶师还会潜伏到这里来。平时大概是疏于修炼了，完全被对方给算计了。不过，这也暴露出了他们的弱点。

units.sourceText: 弱点？
units.referenceText: I will teach you the #rPolearm Mastery#k skill, to reward your actions here. You will be able to improve your accuracy and the overall mastery of your polearm arts.
units.targetZh: 弱点？

units.sourceText: 很忙吗，英雄大人？前不久我使尽各种手段在金银岛上四处探查，终于找到了一个有意思的情报。是关于人偶师的......
units.referenceText: Hello there, Aran. We received a report that the Puppeteer, one of the members of the Black Wing, is currently based #bsomewhere on the deep forest of Sleepywood#k. Your mission is to enter the place and defeat him there, once for all.
units.targetZh: 很忙吗，英雄大人？前不久我使尽各种手段在金银岛上四处探查，终于找到了一个有意思的情报。是关于人偶师的......

units.sourceText: 看样子，你应该已经打败人偶师了......怎么不高兴的样子？发生什么事了？
units.referenceText: You made it, Aran! The Puppeteer now will not disturb the peace at Victoria Island any longer. Furthermore, now we could clearly investigate the doings of the Black Wing here, at Victoria.
units.targetZh: 看样子，你应该已经打败人偶师了......怎么不高兴的样子？发生什么事了？

units.sourceText: 没发现任何有关金银岛封印石的情报。
units.referenceText: They were after the #bcrystal seal of Victoria#k. These seals are what repels the Black Mage to further taking the continents into his grasp at once. Each continent has one, Victoria's now is safe and sound.
units.targetZh: 没发现任何有关金银岛封印石的情报。

units.sourceText: 啊哈！原来事为这事。呵呵呵......完全不用担心。
units.referenceText: For your bravery inputted on these series of missions, I will now reward you properly. Behold, the #rCombo Drain#k Skill: that let's you heal back a portion of damage dealt to the monsters.
units.targetZh: 啊哈！原来事为这事。呵呵呵......完全不用担心。

units.sourceText: 金银岛封印石我已经找到了。你看，呵呵呵。
units.referenceText: Aran, ever since the Puppeteer's ambush on me, I've been thinking it is dangerous to have the #b#t4032323##k around here by myself. So, I need you to deliver the gem to #r#p1201000##k, in Rien, she will know what to do with it.
units.targetZh: 金银岛封印石我已经找到了。你看，呵呵呵。

units.sourceText: 领取物品前，请先在「其他」栏腾出空位。
units.referenceText: Please free a slot on your ETC inventory before receiving the item.
units.targetZh: 领取物品前，请先在「其他」栏腾出空位。

units.sourceText: 黑色之翼的动向，我已经从真相叔叔那里听说了。听说前不久还被他们袭击了一次......你还好吧？咦？这个......这就是金银岛封印石吗？没想到真相叔叔果然比那些家伙们早一步找到金银岛封印石。不知道这颗宝石到底有什么用......只知道这个东西肯定和黑魔法师有关。
units.referenceText: #r#p1002104##k sent the #b#t4032323##k here for safety? Thank goodness, indeed here the gem will be safer than anywhere on Victoria Island. Thank you, #b#h0##k.
units.targetZh: 黑色之翼的动向，我已经从真相叔叔那里听说了。听说前不久还被他们袭击了一次......你还好吧？咦？这个......这就是金银岛封印石吗？没想到真相叔叔果然比那些家伙们早一步找到金银岛封印石。不知道这颗宝石到底有什么用......只知道这个东西肯定和黑魔法师有关。

units.sourceText: 好久不见了，英雄。这段时间等级上升很快嘛？看来你确实很拼命地在修炼啊。很勤奋。有点英雄的架势了。利琳也会为你开心的吧？
units.referenceText: Long time no see! You've leveled up a lot since the last time we met. You must be training really hard. Always hard-working. I'm not surprised. It's exactly what a hero like you would do. I'm sure Lilin will be happy to hear about your progress.
units.targetZh: 好久不见了，英雄。这段时间等级上升很快嘛？看来你确实很拼命地在修炼啊。很勤奋。有点英雄的架势了。利琳也会为你开心的吧？

units.sourceText: 对了，现在不是说这些的时候。我觉得光在金银岛搜集情报似乎情报面太窄，为了拓宽情报面，我已经开始在神秘岛开展搜索。一开始就选择了天空之城，没想到那里果然有问题。
units.referenceText: Anyway, enough small talk. I realized that it might be more effective to search for information in places outside Victoria Island as well, so I've begun investigating in Ossyria. I began with #bOrbis#k and immediately hit the jackpot.
units.targetZh: 对了，现在不是说这些的时候。我觉得光在金银岛搜集情报似乎情报面太窄，为了拓宽情报面，我已经开始在神秘岛开展搜索。一开始就选择了天空之城，没想到那里果然有问题。

units.sourceText: 在神秘岛大陆的天空之城，好像正在发生着什么非比寻常的事。虽然不同于人偶师出现的时候，但总感觉这种奇怪的氛围一定和黑色之翼有关。怎么样，好久没遇到过这么大的事件了。会不会很激动呢？
units.referenceText: It seems like something strange is happening in Orbis in Ossyria. It's a bit different from when we were dealing with the puppeteer, but my instincts tell me it has to do with the Black Wings. Please head over to Orbis.
units.targetZh: 在神秘岛大陆的天空之城，好像正在发生着什么非比寻常的事。虽然不同于人偶师出现的时候，但总感觉这种奇怪的氛围一定和黑色之翼有关。怎么样，好久没遇到过这么大的事件了。会不会很激动呢？

units.sourceText: 那么你准备好了吗？如果你接受的话，#b到天空之城，找到莉萨，向他询问发生在天空之城的奇怪事情......#k是怎么回事就行了。
units.referenceText: #bLisa the Fairy#k in Orbis should know a thing or two. Go see Lisa first, she knows someone that knows the whereabouts of the sealing stone. That person #rwill require a password from you#k, when requested use the #bThere's something strange going on in Orbis....#k keyword to talk to her. Understood?
units.targetZh: 那么你准备好了吗？如果你接受的话，#b到天空之城，找到莉萨，向他询问发生在天空之城的奇怪事情......#k是怎么回事就行了。

units.sourceText: 嗯，你有什么事？
units.referenceText: What is it? I usually don't welcome uninvited guests, but you have a mysterious aura that makes me curious about what you have to say.
units.targetZh: 嗯，你有什么事？

units.sourceText: （你告诉她巨型食人花的事。）
units.referenceText: (You tell her about Giant Nependeath.)
units.targetZh: （你告诉她巨型食人花的事。）

units.sourceText: 巨型食人花？的确是个大麻烦，但我不觉得会真的影响到天空之城。等等，你刚才说巨型食人花在哪来着？
units.referenceText: Giant Nependeath? It's definitely a big problem, but I don't think it's enough to really affect Orbis. Wait, where did you say the Giant Nependeath was, again?
units.targetZh: 巨型食人花？的确是个大麻烦，但我不觉得会真的影响到天空之城。等等，你刚才说巨型食人花在哪来着？

units.sourceText: 人迹罕至的山路。
units.referenceText: Neglected Strolling Path.
units.targetZh: 人迹罕至的山路。

units.sourceText: ……人迹罕至的山路？如果巨型食人花在那里，就说明有人想闯进封印的庭院！可为什么？更重要的是，是谁？
units.referenceText: ...Neglected Strolling Path? If Giant Nependeath is there, someone is trying to enter Sealed Garden! But why? And more importantly, who?
units.targetZh: ……人迹罕至的山路？如果巨型食人花在那里，就说明有人想闯进封印的庭院！可为什么？更重要的是，是谁？

units.sourceText: 封印的庭院？
units.referenceText: Sealed Garden?
units.targetZh: 封印的庭院？

units.sourceText: 我不能告诉你封印庭园的事。如果你想知道，我得先确认你是否配得上这份情报。介意让我窥探一下你的命运吗？
units.referenceText: I can't tell you about Sealed Garden. If you want to find out, I must first see whether you are worthy of the information. Do you mind if I look into your fate?
units.targetZh: 我不能告诉你封印庭园的事。如果你想知道，我得先确认你是否配得上这份情报。介意让我窥探一下你的命运吗？

units.sourceText: 好，现在就来看看你的命运。稍等我一下。
units.referenceText: Well, now let's look into your fate. Give me a second.
units.targetZh: 好，现在就来看看你的命运。稍等我一下。

units.sourceText: 那么，你打败巨人了吗？哦，黑色之翼卧底？他抢走了天空之城的封印石？！哦，不。太可怕了！我们需要尽快想个对策！把情况告诉明珠港的特鲁。
units.referenceText: So, have you defeated the giant? Oh, a Black Wing agent undercover? And he GOT THE SEAL STONE OF ORBIS?! Oh, no. That's horrible! We need to develop countermeasures as soon as possible! Tell the informant on Lith about the situation.
units.targetZh: 那么，你打败巨人了吗？哦，黑色之翼卧底？他抢走了天空之城的封印石？！哦，不。太可怕了！我们需要尽快想个对策！把情况告诉明珠港的特鲁。

units.sourceText: 你回来了，英雄。在天空之城的事情办得怎么样？确实是和黑色之翼有关吧？为什么表情这么凝重？说来听听。
units.referenceText: The Orbis seal has been stolen by the Black Wings? Hmm, that has gone awry. Go tell #bLilin#k about this, she must have something in mind on this situation.
units.targetZh: 你回来了，英雄。在天空之城的事情办得怎么样？确实是和黑色之翼有关吧？为什么表情这么凝重？说来听听。

units.sourceText: 啊，很久不见了。战神。这段事件修炼得还好吧？正好我发现了新的技能想叫你回来呢......你回来的正是时候！
units.referenceText: Oh, hi #h0#! You won't believe what I just uncovered. It's one of your lost skills... What, the seal of Orbis got stolen by the Black Wings? Oh my...
units.targetZh: 啊，很久不见了。战神。这段事件修炼得还好吧？正好我发现了新的技能想叫你回来呢......你回来的正是时候！

units.sourceText: #b（对利琳讲述有关天空之城封印石的事情。）#k
units.referenceText: For now, let me teach you the #bCombo Smash#k, with it you will be able to deal massive amount of damage to many monsters at once. We will need to use it if we want to stand a chance against the Black Wings now, so don't forget it!
units.targetZh: #b（对利琳讲述有关天空之城封印石的事情。）#k

units.sourceText: 这段时间升级很快嘛，英雄大人？我终于又发现了和黑色之翼有关的有趣事情了。这一次咱们早点......#b武陵#k这个村子你知道吗？看来你得去一趟那里。
units.referenceText: Have you been advancing your levels? I found an interesting piece of information about the Black Wings. This time, you'll have to travel quite a bit. Do you know a town called #bMu Lung#k? You'll have to head there.
units.targetZh: 这段时间升级很快嘛，英雄大人？我终于又发现了和黑色之翼有关的有趣事情了。这一次咱们早点......#b武陵#k这个村子你知道吗？看来你得去一趟那里。

units.sourceText: 武陵的#b陈道人#k好像已经和黑色之翼相接触。虽然不知道事情是怎么变成这样的，但信息应该准确无误。
units.referenceText: Apparently, #bMr. Do#k in Mu Lung somehow met with the Black Wings. I don't know the details. Please go and find out why the Black Wings contacted Mr. Do and what exactly happened between them.
units.targetZh: 武陵的#b陈道人#k好像已经和黑色之翼相接触。虽然不知道事情是怎么变成这样的，但信息应该准确无误。

units.sourceText: 你如果准备好的话，#b就请马上去武陵。#k你去查出黑色之翼为什么会和陈道人接触，以及它们之间到底有着怎样的交易。
units.referenceText: Mr. Do is known to be curt, so you are going to have to remain patient while talking to him. Talk to him with the #bI heard you met the Shadow Knight of the Black Wings#k keyword.
units.targetZh: 你如果准备好的话，#b就请马上去武陵。#k你去查出黑色之翼为什么会和陈道人接触，以及它们之间到底有着怎样的交易。

units.sourceText: 虽说也不是什么着急的活儿，不过你这么问总让人觉得有些不爽。我是不是应该让你下次再来找我呢？反正没什么事情，就请让我清净一点行吗？
units.referenceText: Well, I'm not really busy of anything, bit I don't feel like concocting medicine. Can you come back later? If you don't mind, move.
units.targetZh: 虽说也不是什么着急的活儿，不过你这么问总让人觉得有些不爽。我是不是应该让你下次再来找我呢？反正没什么事情，就请让我清净一点行吗？

units.sourceText: 我听说你见过黑色之翼的武士......
units.referenceText: I heard you met the Shadow Knight of the Black Wings.
units.targetZh: 我听说你见过黑色之翼的武士......

units.sourceText: 啊，你是说一身漆黑，眉宇间皱纹很深的那个男人吗？是见过。不但见过而且他有东西放在我这里，让我转交给武公老头子。
units.referenceText: Ah, you mean that guy dressed in black with a menacing wrinkle in his forehead? Why, yes I did. I did meet him. I event got an item for him. He asked me to deliver it to that old man, Mu Gong.
units.targetZh: 啊，你是说一身漆黑，眉宇间皱纹很深的那个男人吗？是见过。不但见过而且他有东西放在我这里，让我转交给武公老头子。

units.sourceText: 东西？
units.referenceText: An item?
units.targetZh: 东西？

units.sourceText: 嗯，好大一个#b画轴#k塞给我，让我一定要转交。他一脸杀气的，好像我不转交的话，他还会来找我似的。哎呦，真是吓死人了。
units.referenceText: Yes, a big #bHanging Scroll#k. He gave it to me without saying much. He just asked me to deliver it. He looked scary, as if he would chase me down if I didn't do as he said. Wheeeeeew, that was an experience.
units.targetZh: 嗯，好大一个#b画轴#k塞给我，让我一定要转交。他一脸杀气的，好像我不转交的话，他还会来找我似的。哎呦，真是吓死人了。

units.sourceText: 然后呢，画轴转交出去了吗？
units.referenceText: So did you deliver the Hanging Scroll to him?
units.targetZh: 然后呢，画轴转交出去了吗？

units.sourceText: 没有，那个......其实出了点问题......你愿意听我说吗？
units.referenceText: Well, the thing is... There is a slight problem, care to listen?
units.targetZh: 没有，那个......其实出了点问题......你愿意听我说吗？

units.sourceText: 是这样的，我正在做一种新药水，当时正好在煮草药，结果没想到画轴一下子掉了进去。我虽然以最快速度把它捞了出来，不过画轴浸水后，上面的字都消失了。
units.referenceText: So what happened was... I was making a new type of medicine, so I filled a pot with water and started boiling some herbs. That's when I made the mistake of... dropping the Hanging Scroll, right into the pot. Oh gosh, I pulled it out as fast as I could, but the Hanging Scroll, was already soaked and the writing on it had already disappeared.
units.targetZh: 是这样的，我正在做一种新药水，当时正好在煮草药，结果没想到画轴一下子掉了进去。我虽然以最快速度把它捞了出来，不过画轴浸水后，上面的字都消失了。

units.sourceText: 于是我就发愁了，这怎么转交给武公老头子啊。于是我决定先把画轴修复好，再转交给他。正好你能帮我一个忙。画轴上面的字是武陵最有名的画师#b津津#k写的，你去的话，他一定会帮你修复画轴的。
units.referenceText: So then I thought, well what's the point of delivering it to Mu Gong? I must first restore the writing on Hanging Scroll. That's why I need you to do something for me. The guy down there writing on Hanging Scroll... is #bJin Jin#k, the greatest artist on all of Mu Lung. I'm sure he'd be able to restore the writing on Hanging Scroll.
units.targetZh: 于是我就发愁了，这怎么转交给武公老头子啊。于是我决定先把画轴修复好，再转交给他。正好你能帮我一个忙。画轴上面的字是武陵最有名的画师#b津津#k写的，你去的话，他一定会帮你修复画轴的。

units.sourceText: 请在你的其他栏背包中腾出一个空位。
units.referenceText: Please free a room on your ETC inventory.
units.targetZh: 请在你的其他栏背包中腾出一个空位。

units.sourceText: 怎么样？画轴修复好了吗？要不看看这上面都写了些什么？
units.referenceText: Oh, you brought the ink. Now let me pour it, cautiously.... Almost there, almost. ... ..... Kyaaa! Th-the letter. It says: 'I'll be there to take your Seal Rock of Mu Lung.'
units.targetZh: 怎么样？画轴修复好了吗？要不看看这上面都写了些什么？

units.sourceText: 封印石......那是很久很久以前，由武陵看管的东西......难道说觊觎它的人又出现了......
units.referenceText: If you want to know more about the Seal Rock of Mu Lung, you will need to pass my test. Prove your valor overpowering me in melee combat, only then I shall recognize you as a worthy knight.
units.targetZh: 封印石......那是很久很久以前，由武陵看管的东西......难道说觊觎它的人又出现了......

units.sourceText: 有人已经在挑战，请等待他挑战结束。
units.referenceText: Someone is already attempting a challenge. Wait for them to finish before you enter.
units.targetZh: 有人已经在挑战，请等待他挑战结束。

units.sourceText: 哇哦，你把墨水带来了。现在让我慢慢地倒。。。。差不多了，差不多了 Kyaaa! 这封信里面. 它说：“我会带你去木龙印章岩石。”
units.referenceText: Oh, you brought the ink. Now let me pour it, cautiously.... Almost there, almost. ... ..... Kyaaa! Th-the letter. It says: 'I'll be there to take your Seal Rock of Mu Lung.'
units.targetZh: 哇哦，你把墨水带来了。现在让我慢慢地倒。。。。差不多了，差不多了 Kyaaa! 这封信里面. 它说：“我会带你去木龙印章岩石。”

units.sourceText: 没想到在数百年的岁月之后，英雄的后裔又重新出现了......也不知道对冒险岛世界师傅还是祸......怎样都无所谓了。好吧......我告诉你有关武陵封印石的事情。
units.referenceText: Who would have thought that the hero's successor would reappear after hundred of years...? Will you bring prosperity to Maple World or will you end its existence? I suppose it really doesn't matter. Alright, I'll tell you what I know about the Seal Stone of Mu Lung.
units.targetZh: 没想到在数百年的岁月之后，英雄的后裔又重新出现了......也不知道对冒险岛世界师傅还是祸......怎样都无所谓了。好吧......我告诉你有关武陵封印石的事情。

units.sourceText: 武陵的封印石所在的地方叫做封印的寺院。那里的入口被隐藏在武陵寺院内。你去仔细观察武陵寺院入口处熊猫提着的灯盏。如果能从中找出#b刻有入口字样的灯盏#k，就可以进入封印的寺院了。暗号是#b道可道非常道。#k
units.referenceText: The Seal Stone of Mu Lung is located at the Sealed Temple. You will find the entrance deep inside the Mu Lung Temple. You can enter the Sealed Temple if you find the pillar with the word 'Entrance' wtritten on it. The password is: #bActions speak better than words#k. Maybe you will find the Shadow Knight there, as he probably is waiting for me there. I think the Hero's sucessor is more able to face him than myself, so prepare yourself.
units.targetZh: 武陵的封印石所在的地方叫做封印的寺院。那里的入口被隐藏在武陵寺院内。你去仔细观察武陵寺院入口处熊猫提着的灯盏。如果能从中找出#b刻有入口字样的灯盏#k，就可以进入封印的寺院了。暗号是#b道可道非常道。#k

units.sourceText: 成功打败了影子武士吗？表情怎么这么凝重......难道说你失败了......
units.referenceText: So you have defeated the Shadow Knight. I have never doubted of your handiwork, and you handled the task well.
units.targetZh: 成功打败了影子武士吗？表情怎么这么凝重......难道说你失败了......

units.sourceText: 原来是这样，武陵的封印石最终还是被抢走了......很遗憾，不过也没办法。我现在也不明白英雄们为什么要把封印石交给武陵。
units.referenceText: But yet, something made you unhappy. What could it be? ... No... Black Wings took away the Seal stone? I'm afraid nothing can be done anymore. I suggest you return to your group tactician, Tru is it?, and tell him about the situation now. Tell him about the loss here in Mu Lung. There's no time to lose, hurry!
units.targetZh: 原来是这样，武陵的封印石最终还是被抢走了......很遗憾，不过也没办法。我现在也不明白英雄们为什么要把封印石交给武陵。

units.sourceText: 战神，你平安回来了！在武陵的任务完成的如何了？#r影子武士#k偷袭了武陵并再次偷走了封印石？那真不幸。至少你没有受伤，我很高兴。
units.referenceText: Aran, you came back home safe! So, how fared the mission in Mu Lung? #rGentleman#k ambushed and stole the seal rock again? That's unfortunate. At least you are unharmed, I'm glad.
units.targetZh: 战神，你平安回来了！在武陵的任务完成的如何了？#r影子武士#k偷袭了武陵并再次偷走了封印石？那真不幸。至少你没有受伤，我很高兴。

units.sourceText: 我研究了一些新的技能，试图帮你找回记忆。好消息的是，我想起了其中一个：#r战神突进#k！有了它，你将能够击退前面的敌人。对你的能力来说是一个很好的提升，对吧？
units.referenceText: I've researched some skill books, trying to trace any lost skills of yours. Good news I found one of them: it's the #rFinal Charge#k! With it you will be able to draw closer opposing monsters at each swipe. It's a fine improvement for your arsenal, isn't it?
units.targetZh: 我研究了一些新的技能，试图帮你找回记忆。好消息的是，我想起了其中一个：#r战神突进#k！有了它，你将能够击退前面的敌人。对你的能力来说是一个很好的提升，对吧？

units.sourceText: 到目前为止，在#r射手村#k和#r艾琳森林#k这两个地区发现了两个封印石。。。事情似乎开始失控了。
units.referenceText: So we have lost #btwo seal stones#k so far, from the neighboring areas of #rOrbis#k and #rMu Lung#k... Things are starting to get out of control, it seems.
units.targetZh: 到目前为止，在#r射手村#k和#r艾琳森林#k这两个地区发现了两个封印石。。。事情似乎开始失控了。

units.sourceText: 战神，你现在要做的就是再次通过#b通往艾琳森林的时光之门#k。这次你一定要找回#r艾琳森林的封印石#k。通过我的情报了解到，#b#p2131002##k有关于那个封印石的线索，#r找到她#k。请一定要做到，我们的世界比以前更需要你的帮助！
units.referenceText: Aran, your next objective will be to use the #btime gate to Ellin#k again. This time you will be retrieving the long lost #rSeal Stone of Ellin Forest#k. According to informations our network have gathered, #b#p2131002##k of that time have a clue about that gem, #rfind her#k. Please be successful on this task, our world is relying on you more than ever!
units.targetZh: 战神，你现在要做的就是再次通过#b通往艾琳森林的时光之门#k。这次你一定要找回#r艾琳森林的封印石#k。通过我的情报了解到，#b#p2131002##k有关于那个封印石的线索，#r找到她#k。请一定要做到，我们的世界比以前更需要你的帮助！

units.sourceText: 战神，你终于回来了！！！你最近怎么样？这么久你去哪了？我们有很多事情需要帮忙。。。
units.referenceText: Aran, you're finally back!!! How you've been doing? Where did you go for so long? We have so much to catch up...
units.targetZh: 战神，你终于回来了！！！你最近怎么样？这么久你去哪了？我们有很多事情需要帮忙。。。

units.sourceText: 战神，我发现了一些令人不安的消息。。。你说你来自东部森林区，对吗？我们追踪并研究了用来支撑进入未来之门的魔法。结果发现那是一种#r时间之门#k。你用的衣服。。。以前从没有人见过。那一定意味着，你一定来自未来。
units.referenceText: Aran, I've discovered some disturbing news... You said you've come from the eastern forest section, right? We traced and studied the magic being used to support the portal over there. It turns out that's of a #rtemporal#k-type. The garments you're using... They were never seen around before. That must mean, #ryou must have come from the future#k.
units.targetZh: 战神，我发现了一些令人不安的消息。。。你说你来自东部森林区，对吗？我们追踪并研究了用来支撑进入未来之门的魔法。结果发现那是一种#r时间之门#k。你用的衣服。。。以前从没有人见过。那一定意味着，你一定来自未来。

units.sourceText: 现在关于这个问题：在你的时间轴上似乎丢失了封印石。。。它是一个强大的神器，可以阻止黑魔法师的军队围攻我们的世界。。如果那个封印石消失了，再没有什么能阻止他了。因为这是一件非常重要的事情，所以要从未来找到我的自我。明白了，把我从未来带走吧！
units.referenceText: Now about the problem: the Seal Stone that seems to have been missing in your timeline... It is a powerful artifact, that prevents the army of the #rBlack Mage#k from laying siege on our world. If that stone goes away, nothing more can prevent him. As this is a matter of great importance, find the #rself of mine#k from the future. I'm actually a #rfairy#k with a great life expectancy, I must be alive even on your timeline. Got it, #rfetch the me from the future#k!
units.targetZh: 现在关于这个问题：在你的时间轴上似乎丢失了封印石。。。它是一个强大的神器，可以阻止黑魔法师的军队围攻我们的世界。。如果那个封印石消失了，再没有什么能阻止他了。因为这是一件非常重要的事情，所以要从未来找到我的自我。明白了，把我从未来带走吧！

units.sourceText: 嗯，你需要给信空出一个背包位置。
units.referenceText: Hm, I will need you to prepare a ETC slot for a letter I need to give you.
units.targetZh: 嗯，你需要给信空出一个背包位置。

units.sourceText: 给，拿着这个。把它交给#r#p1002104##k，里面有一封维护世界和平的信。不要把这个秘密告诉别人。
units.referenceText: Here, take this. Send it to #r#p1002104##k, it contains a relevant matter for protecting this world. Please comply to this request.
units.targetZh: 给，拿着这个。把它交给#r#p1002104##k，里面有一封维护世界和平的信。不要把这个秘密告诉别人。

units.sourceText: 哦，一封写给伦普雷斯的信？贝洛斯家？！
units.referenceText: Oh, a letter for the #rempress#k? From the #bheroes#k?!
units.targetZh: 哦，一封写给伦普雷斯的信？贝洛斯家？！

units.sourceText: 嘿！你能帮我个忙吗？最近 #p20000# 有点奇怪。。。
units.referenceText: Hey! Can you do me a favor? #p20000# seems a bit strange these days...
units.targetZh: 嘿！你能帮我个忙吗？最近 #p20000# 有点奇怪。。。

units.sourceText: 就在最近，他还常常愁眉苦脸地抱怨自己的关节炎，但他突然变得满面笑容!!
units.referenceText: He used to scowl and whine about his arthritis until just recently, but he''s suddenly become all happy and smiley!!
units.targetZh: 就在最近，他还常常愁眉苦脸地抱怨自己的关节炎，但他突然变得满面笑容!!

units.sourceText: 我觉得那个木箱后面有个秘密。你能偷偷地看一下旁边的木箱吗 #p20000#?
units.referenceText: I have a feeling there is a secret behind that wooden box. Could you stealthily look into the wooden box next to #p20000#?
units.targetZh: 我觉得那个木箱后面有个秘密。你能偷偷地看一下旁边的木箱吗 #p20000#?

units.sourceText: 你知道 #p20000# 在哪, 是吗？他在右边。一直往前走，直到你看到维京在哪里，然后穿过那条悬挂的鲨鱼和章鱼，你就会看到约翰。盒子应该就在他旁边.
units.referenceText: You know where #p20000# is, right? He's to the right. Just keep going until you see where Vikin is, then head down past the hanging shark and octopus, and you''ll see John. The box should be right next to him.
units.targetZh: 你知道 #p20000# 在哪, 是吗？他在右边。一直往前走，直到你看到维京在哪里，然后穿过那条悬挂的鲨鱼和章鱼，你就会看到约翰。盒子应该就在他旁边.

units.sourceText: 请确认你的背包里是否还有空位.
units.referenceText: Please open a slot in your ETC inventory first.
units.targetZh: 请确认你的背包里是否还有空位.

units.sourceText: #b嗯，盒子里有一种药材。这可能是什么？你最好把这个带给约翰，问他是什么。#k

units.referenceText: Geez, you found my glasses! Thank you, thank you so much. Now I'm able to see everything again!

units.sourceText: 你不想当拳手？
units.targetZh: 你不想当拳手？

units.sourceText: 已经到了等级30了啊。为了当上拳手而来找我的吗？那么你还真是找对人了。
units.targetZh: 已经到了等级30了啊。为了当上拳手而来找我的吗？那么你还真是找对人了。

units.sourceText: 但我不能直接就让你转职，你要向我见证你的力量和强壮。拳手是一种利用全身和拳头来击退敌人的海盗。所以想做一个优秀的拳手的话要会好好利用拳头才行。一定要记住这一点。

units.sourceText: 醒了吗，小不点?
units.referenceText: Did you sleep well, Evan?
units.targetZh: 醒了吗，小不点?

units.sourceText: #b嗯……妈妈也醒了吗？
units.referenceText: #bYes, what about you, Mom?
units.targetZh: #b嗯……妈妈也醒了吗？

units.sourceText: 嗯……但是你怎么好象没睡着呢？昨天晚上打了一夜的雷。所以才没睡好吗?
units.referenceText: I did as well, but you seem so tired. Are you sure you slept okay? Did the thunder and lightning last night keep you up?
units.targetZh: 嗯……但是你怎么好象没睡着呢？昨天晚上打了一夜的雷。所以才没睡好吗?

units.sourceText: #b不，不是因为那个，是因为做了一个奇怪的梦.
units.referenceText: #bOh, no. It's not that, Mom. I just had a strange dream last night.
units.targetZh: #b不，不是因为那个，是因为做了一个奇怪的梦.

units.sourceText: 奇怪的梦，梦见什么呢?
units.referenceText: A strange dream? What kind of strange dream?
units.targetZh: 奇怪的梦，梦见什么呢?

units.sourceText: #b嗯……
units.referenceText: #bWell...
units.targetZh: #b嗯……

units.sourceText: #b(说明梦见在迷雾中遇到龙的事情.)
units.referenceText: #b(You explain that you met a dragon in your dream.)
units.targetZh: #b(说明梦见在迷雾中遇到龙的事情.)

units.sourceText: 呵呵呵呵，龙？怎么会梦到这个呢？没被吃掉，真是太好了。你做了个有趣的梦，去告诉 #p1013101# 吧。他一定会很高兴的.
units.referenceText: Hahaha, a dragon? That's incredible. I'm glad he didn't swallow you whole! You should tell #p1013101# about your dream. I'm sure he'll enjoy it.
units.targetZh: 呵呵呵呵，龙？怎么会梦到这个呢？没被吃掉，真是太好了。你做了个有趣的梦，去告诉 #p1013101# 吧。他一定会很高兴的.

units.sourceText: 嗯？不想告诉 #p1013101#吗? 真是，兄弟之间应该好好相处嘛.
units.referenceText: Hm? Don't you want to tell #p1013101#? You have to be nice to your brother, dear.
units.targetZh: 嗯？不想告诉 #p1013101#吗? 真是，兄弟之间应该好好相处嘛.

units.sourceText: #b#p1013101##k 去 #b#m100030102##k 给猎犬喂饭了。从家里出去就能见到他了.
units.referenceText: #b#p1013101##k went to the #b#m100030102##k to feed the Bull Dog. You'll see him right outside.
units.targetZh: #b#p1013101##k 去 #b#m100030102##k 给猎犬喂饭了。从家里出去就能见到他了.

units.sourceText: 哦，起来啦，小不点？大清早的，怎么这么大的黑眼圈啊？晚上没睡好吗？什么？做了奇怪的梦？什么梦啊？嗯？梦见遇到了龙？
units.referenceText: Hey, Evan. You up? What's with the dark circles under your eyes? Didn't sleep well? Huh? A strange dream? What was it about? Whoa? A dream about a dragon?

units.sourceText:

units.sourceText: 哈哈。我笑得很开心。哈哈哈。但别胡说了. 喂 #p1013102#, 行吗?
units.referenceText: Haha. I had a good laugh. Hahaha. But enough with that nonsense. Feed #p1013102#, would you?
units.targetZh: 哈哈。我笑得很开心。哈哈哈。但别胡说了. 喂 #p1013102#, 行吗?

units.sourceText: #b什么? 这是 #p1013101#的工作!
units.referenceText: #bWhat? That's #p1013101#'s job!
units.targetZh: #b什么? 这是 #p1013101#的工作!

units.sourceText: 你这个小家伙！我叫你叫我哥哥! 你知道 #p1013102# 有多恨我. 如果我靠近他，他会咬我的。你喂他。他喜欢你.
units.referenceText: You little brat! I told you to call me Older Brother! You know how much #p1013102# hates me. He'll bite me if I go near him. You feed him. He likes you.
units.targetZh: 你这个小家伙！我叫你叫我哥哥! 你知道 #p1013102# 有多恨我. 如果我靠近他，他会咬我的。你喂他。他喜欢你.

units.sourceText: 别再偷懒了。你想看到你弟弟被狗咬吗？快点！再和我谈谈接受这个任务!
units.referenceText: Stop being lazy. Do you want to see your brother bitten by a dog? Hurry up! Talk to me again and accept the quest!
units.targetZh: 别再偷懒了。你想看到你弟弟被狗咬吗？快点！再和我谈谈接受这个任务!

units.sourceText: 去山头 #b左边#k 喂 #b#p1013102##k. 他整个早上都在叫着要喂.
units.referenceText: Hurry up and head #bleft#k to feed #b#p1013102##k. He's been barking to be fed all morning.
units.targetZh: 去山头 #b左边#k 喂 #b#p1013102##k. 他整个早上都在叫着要喂.

units.sourceText: 喂了 #p1013102# 回来找我.
units.referenceText: Feed #p1013102# and come back to see me.
units.targetZh: 喂了 #p1013102# 回来找我.

units.sourceText: 你喂过 #p1013102#了吗? 埃文，你现在应该吃早餐了. 今天的早餐是 #t2022620#. 我把它带来了。嘻嘻。如果你不同意我自己吃 #p1013102#.
units.referenceText: Did you feed #p1013102#? You should have some breakfast now then, Evan. Today's breakfast is a #t2022620#. I've brought it with me. Hee hee. I was going to eat it myself if you didn't agree to feed #p1013102#.
units.targetZh: 你喂过 #p1013102#了吗? 埃文，你现在应该吃早餐了. 今天的早餐是 #t2022620#. 我把它带来了。嘻嘻。如果你不同意我自己吃 #p1013102#.

units.sourceText: 给，我给你弄了个 #b三明治#k, so #b你吃完后再跟妈妈说。她说她有话要跟你说.
units.referenceText: Here, I'll give you this #bSandwich#k, so #bgo talk to mom when you finish eating#k. She says she has something to tell you.

units.sourceText: 哦，什么？你不吃早饭吗？早餐是一天中最重要的一餐！如果你改变主意再跟我说一次。如果你不吃，我就自己吃.
units.referenceText: Oh, what? Aren't you going to have breakfast? Breakfast is the most important meal of the day! Talk to me again if you change your mind. If you don't, I'm going to eat it myself.
